labels: Let him stick up for himself!
That's what I love about him.

options.label: Episode One: The New Head Cheerleader

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, this week we're officially unveiling the new school and mascot, and I think it'd be a big boost to the school if we held a rally.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: However, if the cheerleaders aren't under your control by then, we won't have one, and I'll end the program before things get completely out of hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Mean? $ZOE, whenever we win a football game, you give cupcakes to the team we beat!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want them to feel bad!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's sweet, but a person who gives out pity cupcakes isn't going to get very far being mean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I guess you'll have to figure it out...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Good. Good. Are you capable of being assertive?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! Especially in times of crisis. I always seem to rise up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's how I got on the team in the first place... I went after what I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's the kind of self-confidence I wanted to hear.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You're going to be a doormat if you can't even speak your mind!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... Sometimes I just freeze up like that...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, that is unacceptable for a Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I like that you girls aren't wearing those uniforms anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... `Alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... [color=#e23b3b][i]Alone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ew! Gross!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I knew it was a bad idea to wear whatever we wanted! Great idea, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...
The next day, in a dark, goblin dungeon...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spinning lion frenzy!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your `roaring` attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your [color=#e23b3b][i]roaring[/i][/color] attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!

nodes.text: Next to the nerd table, the cheerleaders stare at $ZOE, waiting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, on three, I guess. One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Don't worry! Never fear! Slay those goblins! Hear our cheer! {

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { You're in a corner, nerves a'plenty! {

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: { That's okay! Roll a twenty! {
Dex tosses his character sheet into the air!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I can't concentrate with all this incessant cheering!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It is `really` distracting...
nodes.text_bbcode: It is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] distracting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't like us here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! You're ruining Ogres 'N' Elves!
In Auto Shop, Megan is welding two motorcycle parts together. Behind her, the cheerleaders gather...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like we practiced... One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: { `Weeeeeeeeeld!` {
nodes.text_bbcode: { [color=#3b78e2][i]Weeeeeeeeeld![/i][/color] {

nodes.text: Megan snarls, lifting her welding hood up!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: First, you're not helping!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And second, you couldn't come up with anything more creative?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We tried... But we don't know anything about cars!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Get out!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or stay... I'm cool with you staying!
Zoe has failed...
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Did you hear that? $ZOE approves!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We'll cheer wherever we want!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Let's go to Jamaica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait...
The cheerleaders head off into the locker room before $ZOE can stop them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This sounds like a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But at least I'm not acting mean like Jessica did...)

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How could you say something like that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, okay! I know I said that there aren't any bad ideas in a brainstorm, but cheering everywhere is ridiculous, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean about it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think that maybe I do! And since I'm not a mean person...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I quit!
The cheerleaders gasp!
Before $ZOE can even consider the ramifications of what she's done...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I'll be new Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, are you sure...?
Amanda runs out in front of the other cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yaaaay! Everyone wears a mascot suit! New cheer formation... A big tower of girls!
The girls try to form a huge tower...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Never mind! Let's go cheer for seagulls!
Confused, the other cheerleaders follow Amanda toward the exit...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You have to skip, or you're off the team!
The cheerleaders skip out, leaving $ZOE all by herself, alone...
It's clear...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You mean, we'll actually be `comfortable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, we'll actually be [color=#3b78e2][i]comfortable.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sweet! I was getting sick of wearing this thing! What's it made out of anyway? Sandpaper?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and cat tongues!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You guys are seriously gross!
$ZOE starts handing out the old cheerleader uniforms!
After everyone changes...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I forgot just `how` comfortable these are!
nodes.text_bbcode: I forgot just [color=#3b78e2][i]how[/i][/color] comfortable these are!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I know! It's like wearing pajamas!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like I made the right call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go get changed, everyone! Meet back out here in ten minutes!
Ten minutes later...
The cheerleaders are standing in front of $ZOE in a mish-mash of outfits...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whenever I wear bright spandex, I feel right at home!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nicole, are you wearing a bikini?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Am I the only one who thought Jessica's uniforms were way conservative?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe this was a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! Now that we got that out of the way, let's get started!
The cheerleaders quickly finish their cupcakes and robotically get into pyramid formation...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! Pyramids create strife between those on the top and those on the bottom! It's `archaic!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! Pyramids create strife between those on the top and those on the bottom! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]archaic![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! It's `our cake!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]our cake![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So let's get in a new shape!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What kind of shape?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How about a straight line?
The cheerleaders giddily form a straight line.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is way better than the pyramid! I can actually see what's going on!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and I don't have 800 pounds on my back!
The girls glare at Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: 400 pounds?
Hector covers Keith's mouth.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What Keith meant to say is he's happy he's not on the bottom anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you guys are so amenable to all my changes!
Later, at the end of practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Done!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This is so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's nice to practice without any pressure from Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Remember the cupcakes?! Squee! Best practice ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully, just the first of many!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had one more item on my agenda before we wrap it up for the day... I wanted to get together...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: To rank hot guys?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee... No, we'll do that later, I promise. But right now I want to huddle up and have a brainstorm!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Brainstorm? That sounds painful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, it won't be, Amanda... Let's discuss different ways we can improve cheerleading! This is the chance for your voice to be heard!
The cheerleaders look blankly at one another...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! I know you've all thought about how to make cheerleading better! Feel free to share!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Well, we could probably develop some creative cheers instead of repeating old ones.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We could try to get our parents to help us out with fundraising campaigns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I like it!
For a moment, the brainstorm seems to stall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember, there are no bad ideas in a brainstorm!
Amanda raises her hand!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tiger petting zoo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Uh... Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for contributing, Amanda!
As soon as $ZOE validates Amanda's idea, the cheerleaders begin to chatter with excitement... Ideas pour out of them!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The next time it rains, let's make a big pool of mud, and just dance in it! It'll be so raw!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That sounds... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I think if I got shot out of a cannon I could do, like, thirty or forty flips in the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That... Uh... That might be dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: More importantly, why are we only cheering for `sports?!` Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: More importantly, why are we only cheering for [color=#e23b3b][i]sports?![/i][/color] Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you say, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to dispose of a lot of cheerleader traditions, so hopefully I'll be taking meanness out of the equation altogether!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's that sad face again...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just want you to be careful making changes, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I became captain of the football team, I thought I could change things too...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted everyone to have a chance to play whatever position they wanted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It wasn't pretty... We had fifty guys trying to play quarterback...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ever seen an offensive lineman try a five-step drop?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that a dance move?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Oh... Right. Forgot who I was talking to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I appreciate you warning me, Howard... But I'm not trying to change a bunch of hot-headed football players...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: These are `cheerleaders...` They're supposed to be flexible!
nodes.text_bbcode: These are [color=#3b78e2][i]cheerleaders...[/i][/color] They're supposed to be flexible!

nodes.text: Later, at practice... $ZOE stands in front of the cheerleading team, a huge smile spread across her face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Welcome to the very first practice `without` Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome to the very first practice [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] Jessica!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders cheer!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: All right! No Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll miss Jessica! She was nice!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Sigh. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait... Isn't this the second practice? We had a half practice on Father's Day, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good point, Keith. Welcome to the first `full` practice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good point, Keith. Welcome to the first [color=#3b78e2][i]full[/i][/color] practice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And to start things off right... I brought cupcakes for everyone!
$ZOE sets a tray of chocolate frosted cupcakes out on a bench... The cheerleaders eye them suspiciously...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are those?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Temptations!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I... I can smell the sugar!
No one makes a move toward the cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You guys, this isn't a trap. As long as I'm Head Cheerleader, you can eat whatever you want! Dig in!
$ZOE steps aside, and the cheerleaders descend upon the cupcakes, wolfing them down!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: These taste just like my mom's!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I love my life!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yum! Goodbye, cupcakes! I'll miss you most of all!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're the best!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I was also thinking instead of wearing the trashy uniforms Jessica gave us, we could start wearing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You cry for the villain in `every` movie we see!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? You cry for the villain in [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] movie we see!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They have families too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sign your name with `three` hearts!
nodes.text_bbcode: You sign your name with [color=#e23b3b][i]three[/i][/color] hearts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a habit! I don't know how else to make that letter!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your car has a bumper sticker that says 'I'd kill with kindness, but I'm too nice for that!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee! It's funny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't make me look pro-murder, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The point is... I'm not worried about you becoming mean... Because that's impossible...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I'm a little hurt you'd even suggest that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Howard, you're supposed to support me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, and I do, but I'm just not sure that you're... Well, mean enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can be mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Say something mean about someone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... You're on! Just tell me who, and I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ummmm, I'll give you an easy one... `Ryan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ummmm, I'll give you an easy one... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ryan.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's easy... He, uh, he has a gap between his teeth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is a fact, not a burn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He likes girls! A lot!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That could easily be a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine! Fine! He's really slimy...
The word 'slimy' hangs there for a second or two, but $ZOE can't handle it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But `only` if you're unable to see his softer, kinder, more sensitive side!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] if you're unable to see his softer, kinder, more sensitive side!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See what I mean? You're a nice person.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that such a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not at all. I love you, $ZOE. I love you `because` you're this nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not at all. I love you, $ZOE. I love you [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] you're this nice.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And hey, I think your capable of `becoming` a good Head Cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: And hey, I think your capable of [color=#e23b3b][i]becoming[/i][/color] a good Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.title: The New Head Cheerleader
nodes.subtitle: Does she have what it takes to lead?

nodes.text: After school one day, $ZOE and Howard walk together toward the gym...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eeeep! Howard, I'm so excited for cheer practice! It's the only thing I've been thinking about all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No kidding...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why do you say that?
Earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Finally! Finally! Finally!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica's gone, and I'm Head Cheerleader! That means no more girl politics! No more drama! Gasp! No more `laundry` duty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica's gone, and I'm Head Cheerleader! That means no more girl politics! No more drama! Gasp! No more [color=#3b78e2][i]laundry[/i][/color] duty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for blabbering like a lunatic! You were saying something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... This is the `guy's` locker room.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... This is the [color=#e23b3b][i]guy's[/i][/color] locker room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, whoops!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee! You don't have a shirt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe I'm transparent! But do you understand how great practice is going to be? It'll be like being hugged by the sun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... That's pretty great... `Hot,` but great.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... That's pretty great... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hot,[/i][/color] but great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Why aren't you smiling? Aren't you excited for me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am, $ZOE, trust me... This day has been a long time coming... And you deserve to revel in Jessica's absence more than anyone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I just think about how Paula, Taylor, and Jessica did really mean things when they were the Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm worried there's a reason they were like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, you're worried that...

options.label: I won't be a good Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love puppies just as much as the next girl, but puppies are fragile, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we did a routine with a bunch of puppies around us, there's a chance we could hurt them...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh no! I wouldn't want that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, who's going to take care of the puppies? Who's going to look after them?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I hadn't thought about all the ramifications...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't be discouraged. I like your ideas. Keep contributing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aaaaaand... `Scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaand... [color=#3b78e2][i]Scene![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think you've got it, $ZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That `was` easy!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] easy!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe you don't like my idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor! I'm not a puppy hater! I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we can try out my idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course we can! Whatever makes this okay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aaaaaand... `Fail!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaand... [color=#3b78e2][i]Fail![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can't be a pushover, $ZOE! You got completely caught up in the emotions of the moment!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I did...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know much about you, Maria...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should totally hang out more!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'd like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice!
The next morning, $ZOE finds Taylor just outside the mobile classrooms...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I figured I might see you sometime soon...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did? Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, hello? Could you make worse Head Cheerleader decisions? Dietary freedom? Brainstorms? What's next? No pyramid?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I got rid of the pyramid for a... A straight line...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! Are you insane?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I messed up, okay! Now I need your help!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My help?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know what it's like to be a Head Cheerleader... If anyone could help me out, it's you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true... You are in a pretty lonely spot without me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have you tried being less `$ZOE` and more assertive?
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you tried being less [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] and more assertive?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I tried that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, that's good... How'd that go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got what I wanted, but now the cheerleaders hate me for it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohhhh, I get it. I see what's going on. You're too nice to make tough choices...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone keeps telling me that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As a leader, you have to be comfortable with your decisions, even if they aren't popular.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I do that `all` the time in Ogres 'N' Elves...
nodes.text_bbcode: I do that [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time in Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be like, 'Erik, we `are` not stopping at `every` inn!'
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be like, 'Erik, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] not stopping at [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] inn!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you feel bad after?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little, but I've learned how to focus less on the feelings I've hurt and more on all the positive results that will come later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you do that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, with Erik, I think about how important it is that we move on. `Every` time we stop at an inn he has Andrew explain every little detail of it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, with Erik, I think about how important it is that we move on. [color=#3b78e2][i]Every[/i][/color] time we stop at an inn he has Andrew explain every little detail of it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What kind of architecture, the history, how the mead's been fermenting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, that's cute.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's obnoxious! We're adventurers, not tourists in the Museum of Boredom!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can see how that might get annoying...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Right? As soon as I remind myself just how annoying it is, I feel better about yelling at Erik. It's easy. Now you try.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll pretend that I want something from you. You turn me down. Then as soon as you start to feel bad for me, try to concentrate on why it's a good decision.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! Let's try it!
Taylor closes her eyes, getting into character. She opens them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, I think it'd be `so` cool if we did our routines, like, surrounded by puppies!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, I think it'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool if we did our routines, like, surrounded by puppies!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't do that. It's not a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't believe it! $ZOE hates puppies!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to focus on why it's a good decision...

nodes.prompt: Why is it a good decision?
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You've always been a good listener, $ZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. Who do you think I should talk to?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: My grandfather always says, 'If you break your foot, don't go to the dentist.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It means when you need help, you should always find the right expert. And we both know who the expert on cheerleading is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Bingo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, now that I think about it...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... I'm glad you liked my story, but that isn't why I told you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I told you because if I had kept my problem to myself, I never would have fixed it!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And you should tell your problems to someone who can help you, someone like Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohhhhh... Yeah, that makes more sense.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sometimes I wonder if you ever listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if that's true, I'm really sorry. I promise I'll start now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, now that I think about it...
As practice wraps up, $ZOE turns to the cheerleaders...
And sees them all glaring at her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay, I have to say something.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Jill!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: After that first practice, we thought this was going to be `our` cheerleading team.
nodes.text_bbcode: After that first practice, we thought this was going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But it's pretty clear after today's practice that the power's gotten to you, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I didn't get to do the stunt I wanted, Erik's still wearing the lizard suit, and you rejected Hector's music idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You guys, someone has to lead!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I guess we know who that is now, don't we?
The cheerleaders angrily walk off to the locker room...
Later, after the cheerleaders have left...
Maria hangs back to talk to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Maria... Are you going to tell me how I'm the bad guy too?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I'm not like that... You know, when I was in grade school, I got picked on a lot because some of the kids found out my middle name.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is your middle name?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Santamaria... I'm Maria Santamaria Gonzalez.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The kids would call me Maria Claus... It drove me crazy. And once they saw that it bothered me, they never let up.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I never told anyone because I thought they were also making fun of my family... I thought if I told my mother, she'd feel just as bad as I did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: One day, when I came home from a particularly bad day, I just broke down and told her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What'd she say?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She told me that it was a special moment in my life to get made fun of for my name, because all my older brothers and sisters had gone through the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All I had to do was turn it on its head. The next day, I came into school dressed like Santa Claus, and I gave all the kids gifts.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: After that, I was cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's a good story...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know why I told you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think so. You want me to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They use a lot of swear words...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's okay! I've got a dubbed out version!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but when rap get dubbed out, it just sounds like a phone call with bad reception.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But the message...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one will be able to get the message if it's dubbed out... I'm sorry, but I just don't think it's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone's ideas are great... Unless they're a guy's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, it's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure it isn't. Let's just dance to girly pop music... Again!
Hector angrily walks away from $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've heard the `No Pants Society` before... They're intense.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've heard the [color=#3b78e2][i]No Pants Society[/i][/color] before... They're intense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just not sure if society can handle all their, um, sickly beats and tight flowers...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Total slang fail aside... You're probably right. Whenever I play them, my uncle's always like, 'Turn that racket off! It's blocking my chakras!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You see?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess... Thanks for at least considering my idea...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem...
Later in practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's work on our dance for the rally!
A pop song plays through the speakers. Hector steps out of the line of cheerleaders, and pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, $ZOE, check it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ever since we had that brainstorm, my noggin's been running extra laps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're always doing these dances, right? But the dances are always set to, well... To super girly music.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What if we kicked off the new school with something edgy? What if we set the rally dance to...
Hector whips out a CD with a trio of guys in shades on the cover!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `The No-Pants Society?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The No-Pants Society?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that a CD?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I can't exactly whip out an mp3 file, can I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: True... I don't know about this, Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's there to know? Their beats are sick, their flows are tight, and every song comes with `a powerful message!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What's there to know? Their beats are sick, their flows are tight, and every song comes with [color=#e23b3b][i]a powerful message![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And really dirty lyrics...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, we can't play `The No-Pants Society` at the rally... I don't think...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, we can't play [color=#3b78e2][i]The No-Pants Society[/i][/color] at the rally... I don't think...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! Jill wore it! Sam wore it! I wore it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's been passed along through the years, worn by dozens of distinguished cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should be honored to wear it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: First, I have to say I feel really oogy now, knowing my skin's mingling with years of girl sweat!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And second, I'm pretty skeptical that this mascot outfit is a rite of passage!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been wearing it for a while now, and I don't think I'm a better cheerleader at all... You know what I think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think this wearing this suit is just a job no one else wants...
Erik sadly shoves his head inside the giant Lyle head and walks away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that went as well as it could have...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really? You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I `was` picking up on some feminine vibes! WoooOOOOOoooob!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] picking up on some feminine vibes! WoooOOOOOoooob!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you just make the sound of feminine vibes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's the sound I wish they made. If they were audible, dating would sure be a whole heck of a lot easier!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE! I feel like a brand new lizard!
Erik happily puts his head inside the giant Lyle head and skips off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Flattery always goes further than I expect it to!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was thinking since we get to wear whatever we want, maybe I could wear something other than the Lyle the Lizard suit!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww... Does that mean no fire?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's exactly what it means... Now, let's form up.
The girls get into line. $ZOE notices Erik standing off to the side wearing the Lyle the Lizard suit...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Could I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, Erik! You know, sometimes you're so quiet I forget you're even a part of the team!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I only get quiet around pretty girls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `I'm` the Head Cheerleader! What I say goes!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the Head Cheerleader! What I say goes!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But you said that there weren't any bad ideas!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In a brainstorm! There aren't any bad ideas `in a brainstorm!` But we're not in a brainstorm now...
nodes.text_bbcode: In a brainstorm! There aren't any bad ideas [color=#3b78e2][i]in a brainstorm![/i][/color] But we're not in a brainstorm now...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Phew! 'Cause I forgot my brain umbrella...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are plenty of bad ideas... And throwing Jill through a flaming hoop is one `for sure!`
nodes.text_bbcode: There are plenty of bad ideas... And throwing Jill through a flaming hoop is one [color=#3b78e2][i]for sure![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I guess you're right. A lot could go wrong.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, now that I think about it, hair dye's really flammable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But, hey, that doesn't mean we can't do other cool stunts! After all, we `have` a trampoline!
nodes.text_bbcode: But, hey, that doesn't mean we can't do other cool stunts! After all, we [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] a trampoline!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Oh yeah! The trampoline's always fun!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Duh. It's called a stunt. It's supposed to be dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why don't you just step aside, $ZOE? Then you won't have to worry about getting hurt!
$ZOE sadly steps aside, trying to figure out what to do as Hector and Maria heft Jill into their arms...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look, if you insist on doing this, I `will` notify Principal Shapiro!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, if you insist on doing this, I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] notify Principal Shapiro!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders groan!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Weak.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Put me down! I didn't realize our new Head Cheerleader was a grade school tattletale!
The next day, at cheer practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I don't get more aggressive, Shapiro will cancel cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, everyone. Today, we're going to...
Jill interrupts her.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I want to work on some new stunts! I talked the Auto Shop guys into rigging this hoop for me.
Jill sets the hoop in a special, suspended clamp high in the air and presses a button on a remote control... The hoop lights on fire!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pretty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Now I just need one of you to toss me through it!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hector and I will do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'll catch you on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awesome! I `love` fire!
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] fire!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys! We can't do this stunt!
The cheerleaders turn to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because...
Nicole sighs and looks back to the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry I even brought it up. Geez... You must think I'm so crazy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think you're upset and having an off day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nicole, you just have to remember that you are important...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You deserve to be listened to... I hope you find girl friends that you get along with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because you really are special.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks... Sniff... No one's ever sat down and told me that before.
Ben puts a comforting arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I just hope I haven't ruined our entire night.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, not at all. It's okay. Really.
They hug.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're a really good guy. Thanks, Ben.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...So, want to make out?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just kidding! Come on, take me home. It gets really chilly out here in the evenings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but you just have to remember that everyone gets crazy once in a while.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, girls tend to act crazier than guys, but you know... We just have different brain patterns.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe this! You're actually calling `me` crazy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe this! You're actually calling [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] crazy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You asked!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, I'll show you crazy! This date is over!
Nicole stands up and picks up food from their picnic basket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, wait, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No one hurts my feelings and gets away with it!
Nicole flings a sandwich at him!
Ben ducks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, hold on... I didn't mean 'crazy' in a bad way!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah right!
Nicole throws a fruit basket! Grapes, strawberries, and a stray cantaloupe piece pelts Ben's shirt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just do me a favor and leave me alone!
In one swift move, Nicole tugs the blanket, sending the remaining food and sand flying everywhere!
She flings the blanket onto Ben, entangling him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Agh! What's going on?!
Ben struggles in the blanket. Over his shuffling, he can hear Nicole's voice.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm leaving... This was a terrible date! I hope the crabs eat your feet!
Nicole storms off the beach.
The next day...
Spencer and Ben talk as Ben makes preparations for his third date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How'd it go with Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For the most part, it was fun.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We had a rough time towards the end, but then...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Things went uphill from there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're really good friends now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You're `good` friends? Friends with Frenching, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah? You're [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] friends? Friends with Frenching, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, we didn't make out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aw, man, you're killing me. These aren't tea parties, these are dates!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It started out great, and we almost kissed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then she started a food fight with me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right! Way to go!  A food fight!
Spencer raises his hand.
Ben shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was a `bad` thing... She started throwing the sandwiches at me, and then she stormed off the beach.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#e23b3b][i]bad[/i][/color] thing... She started throwing the sandwiches at me, and then she stormed off the beach.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I called her later that night to see if she was okay...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that's when she told me I was a loser that she never wanted to see again.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bummer.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Maria? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you two both like the Royal T's. Maybe you could hit it off.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just because we like the same music doesn't mean we'd be great friends...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it might mean you have more in common than you think.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're right, Ben. It's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry you feel so alone.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: My mom? I'm not going to share things with her!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Do you know how totally embarrassing that is?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used to talk to my mom... Before she left us.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You talked to your mom about who you had a crush on? About who you made out with?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, it was pretty easy... Since I hadn't actually kissed anyone until after she was gone...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh... That is so unhelpful, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry. I'm not really good at this stuff.
Ben blanks.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See? You can't even think of anyone who I'd get along with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I just blanked out. What about your mom?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you can be friends with...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Believe me, the cheerleading team does everything together, but that doesn't mean we're all friends.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Outside of cheerleading stuff, I don't see $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Besides, $ZOE has her life together. I can't talk to her about how messed up mine is.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So what do I do right now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So not $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: From what I actually knew about Jessica... She thought of you as her closest friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You both talked to each other, right?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's `gone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but she's [color=#3b78e2][i]gone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you were `friends` with Jessica...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you were [color=#e23b3b][i]friends[/i][/color] with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So it stands to reason that you can make more friends, if you've already made one before.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe you're right...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But what do I do right now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Who were you thinking of? The other cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... What about $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's terrible! Girls feel threatened, and guys don't really care about who I am. No one bothers getting to know `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's terrible! Girls feel threatened, and guys don't really care about who I am. No one bothers getting to know [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know what to do about it though...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I don't know what to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Except that you might get better advice if you talk to another girl about it...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But that's just it. I don't really have any friends to talk to...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't make friends. I can't keep a guy friend to save my life. It's one of the worst things about me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aren't you friends with other girls? What about...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Exactly. Most people think I'm pretty.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I was hoping you were different.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's not an insult, is it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really? You think I'm nice? I'm not sure I believe you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Or did you mean `nice` like `ugly?` Girls do that a lot...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or did you mean [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] like [color=#3b78e2][i]ugly?[/i][/color] Girls do that a lot...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know... That makes sense. Jessica used to describe all my old clothes as 'nice'...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I definitely don't mean that you're ugly...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's the opposite. You're beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But everyone says I'm beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're, uh...
Ben's words die in his throat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You don't have to say anything. It's fine. I'll tell you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Everyone thinks I'm `pretty...`

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Of `course` I like you... You're hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] I like you... You're hot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...That's it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What else is there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Nicole turns away from him abruptly.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No, you're right! You're completely right!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm always trying to make out with guys too quickly! Even before I know if I like them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you do that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't really know...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: According to Chic Magazine, it's the best way to figure out what a guy really thinks of you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is he a Fab Friend, a Friend with Frenching, or just a Fried Fish...?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Or maybe I try to kiss guys quickly because I'm afraid of losing them.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: People don't really like hanging around me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That isn't true...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Isn't it? What do you suppose people think when they look at me?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Before this date, what did you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What am I supposed to say to that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought you were...
Ben leans in, but at the last moment, Nicole pushes him away!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No! I don't want this!
Ben backs away quickly, lifting his hands.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, what's wrong? Are you okay? I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I... I.... That felt weird. We `just` started talking, like, two hours ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I.... That felt weird. We [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] started talking, like, two hours ago...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's too fast... Why did I even do that? Do I even like you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Do you?
Ben suddenly pulls away, causing Nicole to nearly topple over.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why don't you kiss me? Do you not like me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not that... It's just... Don't you think this is too fast?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Probably.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've been enjoying this time with you, but...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You don't like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I didn't say that. I just don't usually kiss this quickly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, we barely know each other. Do you even like me?
Ben walks away from the register. In a second, Spencer comes out, carrying a small bouquet of flowers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are those for an occasion or an apology?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Both. Kind of. More of like an 'I'm sorry I forgot that it's our one month anniversary' gift.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see... Well, I'll see you later, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good luck, bro.
Ben rings Nicole's doorbell. A few seconds later, Nicole flings the door open!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ben, it's so nice to see you!
She throws herself into Ben's arms.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good to see you too... And I have something for you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll get this.
Ben buys the gift card.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hopefully, she likes music...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll get this.
Ben buys the baseball cap.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, she likes visiting colleges.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But let's forget about Jacob... I'm sorry I even brought him up...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This night is about us.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And I'm having a really good time, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know... I really like you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maria, you're great, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think things are going to work out between us.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounds like you're still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And having just dumped Jessica... I'm still a little hung up on her too.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It just doesn't seem like a good idea to date if we're both thinking about other people when we get together.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know what? You're right. I... I am still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I just thought he actually wanted to be with me, so when we broke up...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It didn't seem fair.
Maria gives Ben a sad smile.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, maybe someday if you get your mind off Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if I get my mind off Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then we can try again.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben, for being honest with me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And for making this a fun night anyway.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shall we go home?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, let me walk you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're just not the right girl for me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not really you. It's more about me, you know?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I don't! If it's about you, then why am I the one getting left out?
Maria bursts into tears, and Ben panics.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, wait... Don't cry... Really, you deserve someone better than me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Better than the most popular guy in school?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're worse than Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wish I'd never come out with you!
At that moment, the maitre d' rushes over to the table.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: What seems to be the matter, mine privateers?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing at all!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff... He made me... Cry!
The Captain turns an angry eye on Ben.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: You know our rules here, don't you?
The Captain points to an unfurled scroll on the wall, held in place with nails and a fake dagger.
It reads, 'Terms and Conditions for Walking the Plank'. The Captain points to number 10 on the scroll.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Yer the `second` lad to do this today... If ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yer the [color=#e23b3b][i]second[/i][/color] lad to do this today... If ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, I...
The Captain hauls Ben to his feet and pushes him up a steep ladder leading to a high diving platform.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way...

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Aye, go up there, ye landlubbing lubberman! I know a scurvy dog when I see one!
Ben walks down the edge of the plank and looks into the cold water tank below him. The Captain steps on the platform with him and pushes him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Agghhhhhhh!
Ben crashes into the pool with a loud splash, and everyone cheers!
When Ben comes to the surface, he looks around for Maria, but she is gone.
The next afternoon...
Ben and Spencer are at the mall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How'd your date go?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know... It went okay.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At the end of the night, I felt pretty good about the entire evening.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like Kale did some K-I-S-S-N-G with Maria!
Ben gives Spencer a skeptical look.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, there are two i's in 'kissing', and second, it wasn't like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After she told me she liked me, I turned her down, and then I walked her home.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You turned her down?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. She's still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jacob? Like, Grumpy Baby Face Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Afraid so...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Say no more. If Maria's not into you, forget about her, move on. It didn't work out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maria and I were having an okay time talking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then I walked the plank.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Harper and I have definitely `walked the plank.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Harper and I have definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]walked the plank.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: High five, man!
Spencer puts his hand up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We went to a pirate restaurant. I literally walked the plank.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We didn't kiss... We didn't even hold hands!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, forget all about Maria... So things went bad with her...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now things will definitely work out with Nicole! Are you ready for your hot beach date tonight?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To be honest... No, I'm not ready. After what happened with Maria...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I get the feeling I should stop going out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, man... I know how things not working out makes dating really hard...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But it's supposed to be fun. Just go out there and relax.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Besides, you know Nicole... She makes out with everyone! You can't lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know what your definition of 'winning' is...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, do you know what you're going to get her yet?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You could do roses... Or chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I did that for Maria... It feels cheap to use the same thing on two different girls in a row.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't know that much about Nicole honestly...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, at the date auction, they said she liked music and colleges.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Music, huh? What about a gift card for her phone's music store?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A gift card? That's like giving cash.
Ben looks over and sees a hat with 'Centerscore U' on the brim.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or this?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A hat? Why don't you just tell her that her hair is ugly to her face?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What should I get instead?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know. You're on your own for this one...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I'm going to get something. You can figure your stuff out, can't you?
Spencer runs off as Ben contemplates his two choices...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, he isn't! He's very caring and understanding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know what I said. And Jacob just feels he's too young to commit to anything.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And maybe he's right. Maybe no couple in high school should be that exclusive.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jacob sounds confused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Obviously, he wanted to date you if you kept going out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it doesn't seem like he's that into you since he couldn't make up his mind.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It must be frustrating when you know what you want, but he doesn't.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... It definitely was.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Can I tell you a secret?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I've never told anyone this... But I want to be Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I was never considered...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It seems like I can finally have my chance now that Zoe's stepped down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm glad for you.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're so supportive...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I try.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jacob was never that understanding about all this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You keep mentioning him. Wasn't he your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wish!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Or, rather, I mean, I `wished.` He wasn't interested in committing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or, rather, I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]wished.[/i][/color] He wasn't interested in committing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'd gone on a lot of dates, but he didn't want to use 'labels' or anything.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: He always wanted to 'keep things open'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jacob sounds...

options.label: Like he doesn't know what he wants.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You said you wanted to be in movies since you were little. Where did you grow up?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know, it's been a long time since anyone asked me that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It seems like all anyone ever talks to me about is cheerleading...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Glad I didn't ask you about that then.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I came from kind of a bad background. We used to live on the other side of town!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It was a rough life. Both my parents worked late. I was home alone a lot of the time.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Movies and TV helped me think about moving away from all that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And even though my parents and I moved to a nicer place...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It just always kind of stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm glad I got to know this side of her...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What's to say? I'm a cheerleader, and I'm pretty good at all the routines...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I am so happy that Jessica isn't Head Cheerleader anymore. You have no idea what it was like being under her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I have some idea...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Er, yeah, of course! Sorry! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I kind of knew all this already...
Ben arrives at Maria's house and rings the doorbell. She opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hi, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Girls like flowers...
Ben buys a bouquet of pretty pink and yellow flowers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't go wrong with chocolate...
Ben buys a heart-shaped box of chocolates.
Spencer finds the table where the cheerleaders are collecting money.
Ben runs after him. By the time Ben has made his way through the crowds, Spencer has handed the money over and is talking to Nicole, Sam, and Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...In that case, I'm `really` looking forward to our date!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In that case, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] looking forward to our date!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if this really has to happen... I'm not going to back out.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See you later, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bye!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, not even for a friend?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You won't regret it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, why would you come to buy a date without any money?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your money is in good hands, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. `Mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. [color=#e23b3b][i]Mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't want to do this, but...
Before Ben can blink, Spencer sticks out his foot and pushes Ben to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!
Without missing a beat, Spencer reaches down, plucks Ben's wallet out of his pocket, and takes off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? Don't you think that was a little immature?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'll thank me later!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why'd you come without any money?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We don't all roll in dough, Kale.
Ben forks the money over.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, you won't regret this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope not.
Spencer runs towards the stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, you didn't say you were going to pay me back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Can't hear you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not even talking about having a `girlfriend...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, I'm not even talking about having a [color=#e23b3b][i]girlfriend...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just go on some dates. Have some laughs. Flirt a little.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I can tell by that smile you've got something in mind?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The four greatest words you'll ever hear...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Date auction. `With cheerleaders.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Date auction. [color=#e23b3b][i]With cheerleaders.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A date auction? Is that even legal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's the cheerleaders, dude. I don't think school rules apply to them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What, you'd rather finish off your stupid game than go hang out with your friend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's what I just said, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, if you don't leave this house to come see the cheerleaders with me, I will carry you out like a football...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In your pajamas.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just... Let me change.
At the Cheerleader's Date Auction...
Ben and Spencer slip into the crowd around the stage.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh man, oh man... I have so much money to spend... And I know just who to spend it on!
Onstage, the girls see Ryan and look nervous.
Keith steps in front, raises a microphone, and smiles at the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Welcome to the Cheerleader Fundraiser!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You know the drill... All the lovely ladies on the cheerleading squad are willing to go on a date with anyone who wants to contribute!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And first up, we have Amanda! Amanda loves unicorns, sparkles, and partying!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We'll be starting the opening bid at five dollars... Any takers?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ten dollars!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We have ten... Anyone else? Oh, there's fifteen! And twenty!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thirty dollars!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And thirty dollars is our top bet... Wait, I see forty! And fifty! Whoa, Amanda's going up fast!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sixty dollars!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And we have sixty dollars... Anyone else? It's going... Going...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Seventy dollars!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! I don't have that much!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, seventy is the new high bid... It's going... Going... Gone! Seventy dollars to Erik Ericson!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! A fun night with Amanda? I can't wait to see what we'll do!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `It won't be much.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It won't be much.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole steps on stage.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And next up, we have Nicole! Nicole loves partying at clubs, dancing on tables, and visiting college campuses!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Any bids for Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: ...I hear five dollars! Anyone for ten?
In the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You should bet on her, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know... Not only does this feel wrong...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm just not into the entire dating thing...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Look, if you're not going to bid on Nicole, then I am.
Spencer raises his hand.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Twenty bucks!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Twenty! Anyone have twenty-five?
The numbers keep rising...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And I have forty... Any last bids?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fifty!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Fifty dollars to our football superstar Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And next up, we have the lovely Maria!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maria is interested in fashion and movies, and she's a romantic at heart who enjoys flowers and candlelit dinners.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We'll start the bidding at five dollars. Five dollars?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Five dollars!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ten dollars!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We have ten dollars!
Ben shoots Spencer a confused look.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're bidding on `two` dates?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're bidding on [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] dates?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heck yeah! If you're going to date, you need to get out there!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And another date goes to Spencer for forty-five!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And that's it for our cheerleaders... If you donated tonight, you can make payments to...
Suddenly Keith is cut off.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! I've been waiting for my date all evening... What about $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: $ZOE! $ZOE! $ZOE!
$ZOE steps onstage and takes the mic from Keith.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello all... Sorry to disappoint, but Keith is right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it for our cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's not it for the evening! We have one last date to auction off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My beautiful cousin, Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's all welcome Samantha up here!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, it's not $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But it's good enough!
$ZOE pulls a surprised Sam onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam has an amazing personality and is a talented athlete! She's been a little sad lately, and she's hoping to go out with someone who'll really cheer her up!
Sam glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... We'll be starting the bidding at five dollars!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You `so` owe me for this.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] owe me for this.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, okay... Do I hear five for Sam?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Five dollars!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now, you're just getting greedy, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up, man! I can't let `Ryan` take Samface out on a date!
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up, man! I can't let [color=#e23b3b][i]Ryan[/i][/color] take Samface out on a date!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Anyone for fifteen dollars?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fifteen!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: One hundred dollars!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'm sorry... You have one hundred dollars?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh... Any higher bids?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Because otherwise, I think Ryan wins...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This is going to be the `greatest` day of my life...
nodes.text_bbcode: This is going to be the [color=#e23b3b][i]greatest[/i][/color] day of my life...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: One hundred and ten dollars!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Noooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The winner is Spencer! Spencer, you have won a lovely date with Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great... I guess a date with my ex-boyfriend is better than a date with Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And that's it. Can all our winners please come up here and donate your money for your date?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!
Spencer takes his wallet out, opens it, and frowns at what he sees. He pockets his wallet and smiles at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey Ben... Do you have whatever fifty plus forty-five plus one hundred and ten is?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Breaking up with Jessica was really hard.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I loved her, and she just used me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought she made me happy, but that turned out not to be true.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How can I just forget all that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, I get that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But that means you have to get out of this funk you're in...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can't just stay here.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They just build you up and then tear you down.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who needs one? I don't.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Besides, do you know how awesome it is being by myself?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can play video games as much as I want... I don't have someone telling me to go shopping with her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I'm saving so much money from my allowance... It's going straight into my college fund.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're really bragging about that, huh?

nodes.text: It's a beautiful afternoon in the city of Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Ben

Ben takes his sandwich and walks into the lightless den, where a video game console is hooked up to the large TV.

Later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing?! I was just about to finish him off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm saving you from yourself, man. What have you been doing all weekend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Playing this video game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' `by yourself` in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' [color=#e23b3b][i]by yourself[/i][/color] in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're wearing a blanket, you haven't showered, and you're surrounded by moldy food!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...What do you want, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I came to get you out of here. You need to leave your house.

nodes.text: Like, Friday night? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what time is it now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Saturday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Try three in the afternoon on Sunday!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's time to admit you've got a problem...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you were `'fine',` you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...
nodes.text_bbcode: If you were [color=#e23b3b][i]'fine',[/i][/color] you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `If you were fine`...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If you were fine[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Okay, I get it! I'm not 'fine' at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
