nodes.text: Grr!
Sam storms off! She marches back across the beach and past the crowd... $ZOE runs after her...
In the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Home!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, talk to me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't stand seeing Nick and Sara together, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't understand... They're not `together` together, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand... They're not [color=#3b78e2][i]together[/i][/color] together, right?

nodes.text: Sam sighs...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...On the swim team trip, I went for a walk through this garden outside the hotel, and I saw them kissing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam... I'm really sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks. Bye. I'm going home!
She opens her car door...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, wait! Please don't go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Give me one good reason not to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
$ZOE starts doing a conga dance for Sam, gyrating her hips and shaking her fists from side to side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Doop doop doop! {

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, you look really silly...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on... There are a million people going to the party! You won't even notice Nick and Sara! It'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine!
Sam slams her car door!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you have to promise me that you'll introduce me to a...
All the guys stare at Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we didn't have enough postage for an invitation!
They all burst into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, we know you didn't forget your sense of humor!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm glad you're at a point where you can make light of your break up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not easy, bro. Not an easy thing to do at all...
As the laughter subsides, Ben notices that Carson still seems worried.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Carson, would it help if we went over everything... Kind of like a collective mental checklist?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Actually, that would alleviate so many of my worries... Thank you!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's what a party bro is for!
Hector and $Scott exchange an uneasy look...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: What are you implying?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm implying that you're acting crazy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everyone here is a party master! We haven't forgotten anything. You can either be negative about it, or you can just let things be `perfect...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone here is a party master! We haven't forgotten anything. You can either be negative about it, or you can just let things be [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Instead of acting like a party rookie...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How dare you call me that!
Carson tosses a hula skirt at Ben's feet! $Scott steps in between them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa... Take it easy, guys. Let's just go over everything together... One final checklist.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Fine. At least someone here respects me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Carson.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I think Ben here forgot his tongue!
Hector and $Scott laugh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not always quick on my feet, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha ha! Seriously! Seriously! Can we have a mental checklist pow-wow together?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ben, you might want to sit this one out. It requires complicated brain functions... Like speaking!
Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!

nodes.title: The Island Party
nodes.subtitle: Will Sam break up Nick and Sara?

nodes.text: Ben, Hector, $Scott, and Carson stand together on the pier that extends from Centerscore Beach...
On the sand nearby, a crowd of students waits in line, preparing to board a huge ferry boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gentlemen, we've pooled together our respective party prowesses to throw a truly magnificent gala!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Or...` Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of `All Time!` Boom! Coined it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Or...[/i][/color] Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of [color=#e23b3b][i]All Time![/i][/color] Boom! Coined it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Carson shakes his head...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know how you guys convinced Prissy to let you throw a party on her dad's island, but this is awesome! I'm going to miss partying with my bros!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We will too, man! Hector, have we done everything we need to do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHH!` Are you guys insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color] Are you guys insane?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Carson? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not at all! Don't you know the laws of jinxing?! Every time you call something perfect, you jinx it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Or have none of you thrown a party before?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've `all` thrown parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] thrown parties.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Then I don't need to remind you that something `always` goes wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I don't need to remind you that something [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] goes wrong!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We `are` perfect!
nodes.text_bbcode: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] perfect!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHHHH!` Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHH![/i][/color] Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, man...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm glad someone has some sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we totally forgot...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sara's not mad at me about the volleyball, is she?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so... But Sara doesn't seem like the type to be mad at anyone for very long... Or ever.
Sam takes a deep, calming breath...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! I won't send it... For now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talking to Erik really cheered me up... I laughed a lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you've met Erik before...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's nice `and` to prove that he's not like a certain `other` guy...
nodes.text_bbcode: He's nice [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] to prove that he's not like a certain [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, how do you feel about athletes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Athletes are the paramount of physical achievement!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I would give my arm to be an athlete!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Although, that might limit the sports I could play...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Enjoy!
$ZOE winks at Sam and goes over to talk to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did I just pass a test?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, just so you understand, I had $ZOE bring you over here so I could get my mind off Nick and Sara...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm not interested or anything... Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! You can call me Mr. Platonic!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm probably not going to do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And hey, if it's a distraction you need, let me tell you all about my character in Ogres 'N' Elves!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He's a one-armed giant named Big Gruff!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it with you and arms?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, `The Innie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how much fake money do you have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To be honest... None. I spent it all on a magical donkey, but I haven't seen any of the fruits of my labor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just a lot of magical donkey dung...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee... You're kind of funny, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Weird, but funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For distracting me... Even for just a little while...
On the island, $ZOE approaches Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, this is...
Ben has failed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess it couldn't hurt to Colt something for once in my life...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That phrase is really catching on...
Ben hops into the boat with the pig, and Colt pilots it away from the dock and out toward the island...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, Colt... I'm not going to stoop to your level. It's wrong to steal!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Suit yourself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come here, piggy!
Colt takes the pig and shoves off from the dock... Ben watches, now alone.
From this distance, he can barely make out the distant island, the sounds of a thriving party...
The sounds of faint island rhythms...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guess I missed the boat... Twice.
He stays there on the beach, waiting but without knowing what he's waiting for...
Well, stealing is definitely wrong... And taking the moral path isn't the `worst` thing Ben could do...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, stealing is definitely wrong... And taking the moral path isn't the [b]worst[/b] thing Ben could do...

nodes.text: But it might be nice for him to be spontaneous every once in a while, right?
Try again and see what happens if Ben follows along with Colt's plan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where's my nice guy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So? A promise is a promise!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't calm down, $ZOE! I'm too upset!
Sam presses SEND!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! No!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's done!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you, Sam! You just posted something on the Dirty Dish!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You just broke up a couple!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like you're... It's like you're...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like you're Jessica!
Sam might not as bad as Jessica was, but she definitely shouldn't let her anger reduce her to something so vile!
Try to help her stay calm again and see if she can show some restraint during a difficult time...
Sam has failed.
