nodes.text: Before anyone says anything more, Sam storms off, anger seething through her!
As the sun sets, Sam marches to the docks, pulls out her phone, and types up a message to the Dirty Dish...

nodes.speaker: Message
nodes.text: 'Guess who Nick Brown's dating now?! Sara Kessler!'
Her finger hovers over the SEND key. $ZOE comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam? Sam, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I'm not okay, $ZOE! The guy I like left me... And now I have to watch him flirt with one of my teammates! It's always the same! Nothing ever works out for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing with your phone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No point in trying to hide it from you... I'm going to send `this` to the Dirty Dish!
nodes.text_bbcode: No point in trying to hide it from you... I'm going to send [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] to the Dirty Dish!

nodes.text: She holds the phone up for $ZOE to read...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gasp! Sam, you can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If this ends up on the Dirty Dish, Sara's dad will find out about it! It will ruin her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's the point!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Her dad will force her to dump Nick! You'll be breaking them up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You do? I know you're angry, but this isn't right, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Sara's dad is wrong for putting so much pressure on her, and Sara's wrong for keeping her relationship from him, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's none of your business...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think you know what you're talking about! How is Nick's girlfriend `not` my business?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think you know what you're talking about! How is Nick's girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] my business?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because you're not his girlfriend anymore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't the way my cousin behaves... You've got to calm down!
Sam looks at the message... The SEND key glows temptingly in front of her...
The ball slams into Nick's stomach!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Oog!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oog![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You deserve that!
Sara crouches down next to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You okay? That was quite a spike you just took...
The ball flies toward Sara's head, but she ducks out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I should have known Sara would be fast enough to dodge that...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nice moves, Sara!
Unsure of who to spike the ball at, Sam closes her eyes and spikes the ball hard!
Meanwhile, at the island party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not having any fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! But Sam, there are tiki torches and drinks in coconuts and...
A song with steel drums melodiously wafts through a nearby set of speakers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And island rhythms!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other `everywhere` I go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other [color=#3b78e2][i]everywhere[/i][/color] I go!

nodes.text: A couple yards away, Nick playfully touches Sara's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee! That sounds like a really funny picture!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The only thing that would make this worse would be some kind of lame ice-breaker game like...
Carson bounds into their midst...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Who's up for Truth or Volleyball? It's a new twist on an old favorite!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh...
A few minutes later, Sam, $ZOE, and the cheerleaders are standing on the opposite side of a net from Nick, Sara, and the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You sure you want to be on that side, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Positive. Let's get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We'll start with Jill...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Uh... Nick... Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Truth!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Do you have feelings for someone on this court right now?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh! Juicy! I bet he's still got feelings for Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I do have feelings for `someone...` Yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: I do have feelings for [color=#e23b3b][i]someone...[/i][/color] Yeah.

nodes.text: Everyone gasps!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I love this game. Hannah, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam! Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Volleyball.
Hannah takes the ball and hits it over the net... Jill digs it out, Maria sets it for Sam, and Sam coils her arm back to spike it at...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll be in the car...
Howard trudges off toward the car...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where's Howard going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We, um, just remembered that we have a dentist appointment!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You guys go to the dentist together?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's extreme tooth care!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I hate the dentist! She's always telling me to stop eating so much candy! My body, my rights!
As $ZOE heads over to her car, she sees Howard sitting slumped in the passenger seat. A deep worry fills her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen Howard like this before... There must be something I can do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... I know what'll cheer him up!
$ZOE pulls out her phone...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hello? $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Bryce! I need a favor...
Early the next morning, $ZOE knocks lightly on the door to Howard's house... Eventually, it opens...
Howard is standing there in his pajamas, his hair sticking out every which way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing here, $ZOE? It's... Like... Four in the morning or something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not `that` early! Besides, I have a surprise for you! Get dressed!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] early! Besides, I have a surprise for you! Get dressed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mrmph.
A few minutes later, $ZOE is once again driving Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is this another attempt to cheer me up? Because the last one didn't take.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I told you that I don't want to be around people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you do... You just haven't been spending time with `the right` people!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you do... You just haven't been spending time with [color=#3b78e2][i]the right[/i][/color] people!

nodes.text: After a lengthy drive, $ZOE and Howard arrive at Centerscore U!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What have you got planned?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing much... Ready to get your college on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's times like these when I realize I don't deserve someone as nice as you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, stop it. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The representative from Kingston University is coming here soon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie wants to get into this special program, and she has to impress him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She can't impress him somewhere else?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's already set. She made a mistake. She knows it.
All of the delight that had been on Howard's face is gone...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for telling me. That couldn't have been easy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE looks deep into Howard's eyes... And she just can't muster the will to tell him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Before I tell you, remember how much fun we had over Fourth of July!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wasn't that a blast! No pun intended, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we even got to repel Wilson High's attack. I remember you were so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just give me the bad news now, okay? There's no point in delaying it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine...
$ZOE tells Howard about the Kingston representative. The joy that had been on Howard's face leaves him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I see why you hesitated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just tell me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I think it'd be best if I told him.
$ZOE walks over to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So then I just ran as fast as I could!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was amazing! He might have broken the land speed record!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wish you guys had taken a picture of Alexei covered in lizards!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I believe the sound he made was `Yaaaaaaaaaaab!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe the sound he made was [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaaaaaaaaaab![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, Howard? Can I talk to you for a second?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure...
$ZOE pulls Howard aside...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you know what, $ZOE? This has been kinda fun. You were totally right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I feel a lot more cheerful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hold that feeling... There's something I have to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Then why do I feel so bad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because it only `feels` like you did something wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because it only [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] like you did something wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like you said, you're busy tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And even though seeing the rep is going to devastate Howard, you didn't have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not like you could have scheduled the meeting for later today or tried harder to fit him into your schedule tomorrow or anything...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh... Actually... I probably could have...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Kites are like birds without wings!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess I'll tell Howard about my mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have scheduled his arrival for after the gathering...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have rescheduled whatever you have going on tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't think of that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have asked me first!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm... I'm really sorry, $ZOE. Can you forgive me? Please?
$ZOE looks across to Howard, who is blissfully recounting the events of Operation Lizard Blizzard. She sighs.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I forgive you. I'm just upset because it looks like Howard's finally enjoying himself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this is going to be tough for him to hear.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess I'll tell him...
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Howard arrive at the park.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! We're here!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I love seeing you guys! You're always so...
Amanda sees Howard's face...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Never mind! Has anyone looked at the sky?! It's `sooooooo` blue!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind! Has anyone looked at the sky?! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]sooooooo[/i][/color] blue!

nodes.text: Hector comes over and pats Howard on the back!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My bro! Ben and I were just telling $Scott the deets of our epic prank on Wilson's graduation!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, tell him about `Operation Baby Lizards Everywhere!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, tell him about [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation Baby Lizards Everywhere![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude! I told you... I'm in charge of naming stuff. We're calling it `Operation Lizard Blizzard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! I told you... I'm in charge of naming stuff. We're calling it [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation Lizard Blizzard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That `is` better...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] better...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That day was pretty fun...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now that you're going to be heading off to college, I bet more and more of your days are going to be like that one...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, man! Football, pranks, parties! I can't wait for the day I get to go to Centerscore U!
Nearby, $ZOE and Amanda are talking, while Angie is off by herself on a phone call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, the sky is pretty blue, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know! Have you looked at lakes? Those are blue too!
Angie returns...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry... I had to take that call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you don't mind my asking, who was it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It was the representative from Kingston University...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, by the way! I heard you got in!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I really want to get into their business school program... But in order to do that, I have to impress their rep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you did! You're an impressive student, Angie!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's not just about being impressive. Incoming Kingston students have to demonstrate particular qualities `face-to-face,` depending on their field of concentration.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not just about being impressive. Incoming Kingston students have to demonstrate particular qualities [color=#3b78e2][i]face-to-face,[/i][/color] depending on their field of concentration.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My field of concentration is blue!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway... The representative is only in Centerscore for today and tomorrow, and I'm really busy tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So...
Angie leans in and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So I told him to come by the park!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why is that a problem? Oh no! Is he afraid of kites?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no way Howard can handle seeing the Kingston rep now! Not after what happened!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm really sorry... I just didn't have another choice!
$ZOE sings along...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { I'm so lucky... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { To be with you... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { And I'll be lucky... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { As long as we are two... {
Howard reaches over and turns the radio off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. I love it when you sing. I'm just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not in the mood... It's too sad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's okay...
They ride on in silence...
As Howard presses his head against the window, $ZOE casually presses the button that rolls the window down!
`Bzzzzrp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Bzzzzrp![/b]

nodes.text: Howard's head slides down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!
$ZOE rolls the window back up...
`Bzzzzrp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Bzzzzrp![/b]

nodes.text: And Howard's head rises up with it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you having fun over there?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Quite a bit actually.
Howard sits up in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, I'll try to enjoy this 'gathering'.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I owe you one for the window trick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...
$ZOE buries her head in her hands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I admit it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As sad as I feel knowing Howard won't attend the school he wants...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Another part of me is really really `really` happy about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Another part of me is really really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] happy about it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's only natural...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it? Is it, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you love someone, you're supposed to want the best for them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I am, selfishly wanting the best for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It may not feel nice, but don't you at least feel relief for getting that out in the open?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I feel awful and horrible all at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not a horrible person, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I am an awful one!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not what I said!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't have to say it, Sam. I already feel it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But nice try, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had to give it a shot... You know, you're less of a pushover than you used to be!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Publicly exposing Jessica's evil will do that to a girl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have avoided confessing my awful feelings to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they're still my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!

nodes.text: Sam sits down on the bed next to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Howard's really sad about all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... He's pretty down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That surprises me... I always thought of him as a Centerscore U. kind of guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did too. I think maybe everyone did...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you've already got some super sweet plan to cheer him up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know me so well! I planned a picnic with some friends...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope it works...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too...
The next day, $ZOE is driving Howard to the park...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is this event we're going to again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a little gathering I put together for you and some of your friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you could use some cheering up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really want to be cheered up right now, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you don't. No one ever `wants` to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you don't. No one ever [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that logic...
Howard presses his head against the car window... A slow pop song comes on the radio...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's all Jessica's fault, you know. She totally ruined his chances with the Kingston interviewer by getting Ryan to pick a fight with him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're going to just avoid the subject altogether?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not the $ZOE I know. The $ZOE I know is compelled to tell the truth...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I am telling the truth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay... Technically, you haven't lied. But we both know you're feeling at least a little bit happy that Howard's going to be closer to home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you have this insatiable urge to get that out? To tell me how you're really feeling?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kingston was Howard's top choice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not talking about Howard, $ZOE! You can't tell me you don't feel even a smidge of guilty happiness?
Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!
The morning after the island party, $ZOE and Sam are talking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you missed the rest of Hector's party games... They were so bad that they were actually entertaining!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's worse than Spin the Coconut?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bobbing for Pineapples.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Erik said it was like making out with an underwater porcupine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where'd you go anyway? I was talking to Amanda, then I turned around, and you were gone! I got worried...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I saw Nick kissing Sara... I couldn't bear it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, then I don't blame you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! You didn't decide to post the message about their relationship to The Dirty Dish, did you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's just say sometimes `not` doing something is the best decision you can make...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's just say sometimes [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] doing something is the best decision you can make...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay! I'm really proud of you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! I couldn't have done it without you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But enough about my stuff. What about you, cuz? How are you doing with this whole Howard going to Centerscore U. thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, um... Okay... I guess. I mean, he really wanted to go to Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, travel time to your boyfriend just dropped from twenty hours to twenty minutes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some part of you has got to feel happy about that!
Joy fills $ZOE...
Howard clears his throat...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The reason we play sports is to bring people together for an incredible competition...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A live event that thrills us, all of us, in one moment.
The professor claps his hands together!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Bravo! What's your name, son?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Howard.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Howard! My new favorite pupil! See me after class!
After class, $ZOE and Howard approach the professor.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: My new favorite pupil, Howard, and his... Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yup! I'm $ZOE. We loved your class!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Delightful! Howard, why haven't I seen you in my class before?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not actually in your class, sir. I'm going to be attending Centerscore U. in the fall.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Great gravy! You're as new as they get! Are you planning on getting into sports medicine?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: What have you studied so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard just graduated from high school. He hasn't...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've done some research on contributing factors to musculoskeletal injuries and I've read articles related to concussion prevention in football...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Particularly in younger athletes.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Impressive.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, what are some other classes I might end up taking if I wanted to become a sports medicine major?
The professor shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: None.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: There is no sports medicine major here at Centerscore U. If you really wanted to get into that field, you'd have to go to another college...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like Kingston University?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: They have an excellent program there, yes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Um... Thanks... Come on, $ZOE... Let's go home.
On the road home, $ZOE and Howard sit in silence for a long while.
Finally, as the car turns the corner onto his street, Howard takes a deep breath and speaks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you so much for doing this for me, $ZOE. It meant the world to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had a good time?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This was one of the greatest days of my life!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My girlfriend showed me how much fun I'm going to have at the college I'm going to. What other guy is this lucky?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about you feeling like college will just be a repeat of high school? Or the pressure to play football? Or the lack of a sports medicine major?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, all those things aren't really that big of a deal. If college is anything like the time I've spent with you in high school... Then that's fine by me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And like I said, football `is` fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: And like I said, football [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about your major?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The more I think about it, the more I see sports medicine and Kingston as like this really desperate attempt to be something I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Centerscore U. `is` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Centerscore U. [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to go to great parties, I'm going to play football, I'm going to take fun classes... It's my future!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But is it what you want?
$ZOE stops the car in front of Howard's house. Howard turns to her and touches her face gently...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, do I want to have someone like you living a stone's throw away? Someone so perfect, someone who would plan a day like today for me?
He kisses her with all the love he's ever felt for her. At long last... They part.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course it's what I want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is what you're interested in... Why not get the full experience, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're the best... You're always supporting me!
Howard raises his hand...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Yes! A thought on the matter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't high school. You don't want to disrupt things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm not really in high school anymore, am I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that's true...
The professor catches them talking and singles Howard out!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Young man, is there something you'd like to add to this discussion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're not even making sense!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When we were out there playing, it felt just like when we were back in high school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I always thought when I went to college, things would be different, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's like I'm already on this... Path. I mean, look at $USR and Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the way things are here. I'll be $USR's sidekick again. We'll play football. I'll probably join M.A.N., and everything will go how it always goes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't have to be that way. If you don't want to play football, you don't have to!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How would I explain that to the guys? Besides, it's not like I hate football.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'm just feeling a little lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I've got an idea. Why don't we go check out one of the classes here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those will be `very` different from high school classes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Those will be [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] different from high school classes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, that sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know just the class too!
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Howard step into a large, auditorium-sized classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... `This` is a class? You could fit three hundred people in here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... [color=#e23b3b][i]This[/i][/color] is a class? You could fit three hundred people in here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Not like high school at all, is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Understatement of the year...
As students begin trickling in, $ZOE sees an old man wearing a tie come in through a side door near the front of the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That must be the professor.
$ZOE and Howard find seats. The professor places a tattered briefcase on the table in the front.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He looks so old-fashioned and boring... Why'd you pick `this` class?
nodes.text_bbcode: He looks so old-fashioned and boring... Why'd you pick [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] class?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll see...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Welcome! Welcome! Welcome! Today's subject is Medicine in Sports: The Itch to Cure Jocks!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: If you're here for jock itch, well, I'm not that kind of doctor.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Haha`ha!` Never mind... This guy's great!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha[color=#e23b3b][i]ha![/i][/color] Never mind... This guy's great!

nodes.text: Howard playfully nudges $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it's a class on sports medicine... The field I want to study!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have chosen it for just that reason...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: To start today's lesson, I wanted to ask all of you, some who are presumably intending to become sports physicians...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: And some who took this class because it's been correctly labeled as an `easy A.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And some who took this class because it's been correctly labeled as an [color=#e23b3b][i]easy A.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The students chuckle.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Why? Why is this field important? Why do we care about our athletes?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Most importantly, why do sports matter?
The professor looks around... A familiar guy near the front raises his hand.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Sports allow us to express our deepest emotions... Like anger... Or sadness.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: True...  Sports certainly have an emotional component... But you can get feelings from other, less competitive activities...
$ZOE sees Howard stir in his seat... A dark-haired girl in the back raises her hand.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Athletes are symbols of beauty. The human form at its peak.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Indeed! But if my gym is any indicator, we can reach peak human form without sports.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: And no one is really buying tickets to watch people workout, are they?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hey, if my gym sold tickets, I'd watch!
The class laughs.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: No, I kid. I kid. But, Funny Guy, why don't you tell me why you think sports matter? Go!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh, well, uh...
Howard leans over toward $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I think I know the answer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you should...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. I mean, it's always nice to see those guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then what is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's it. You know me so well...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could I not know my Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now why don't you tell me about it?
Howard grabs a muffin and takes a big bite.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Delicious!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Let me try one of those!
Bryce and $USR grab muffins.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: $ZOE, thanks for all your help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank `you` for letting us crash your party.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] for letting us crash your party.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You and Howard are welcome here any time!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad Bryce feels so comfortable inviting people into `my` sorority!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm glad Bryce feels so comfortable inviting people into [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] sorority!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh. Well, our frat will always welcome you two in if you want to visit again during the summer.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you thinking of rushing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know... I hadn't really thought about it.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: You should do it! It's practically tradition!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I did it, $USR did it, and so did Chuck! My cousin's a few years older than I am, and he did exactly the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's gonna be great! Playin' football, slackin' off in class... We'll show you the ropes.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Hey, speaking of football... Do you want to play?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Come on! It'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Yeah, I bet all the guys will be up for a little game.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. Sure. Let's go.
And so, Howard and the guys set up on the football field while $ZOE cheers from the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Good catch, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard is such a good football player.
An hour later, the guys finish up the game.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: That was so fun! Just like old times, huh, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You guys were always the perfect duo back in high school. With the two of you on the field, we'll be unstoppable!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, Flash, we better head back to M.A.N. We've got a meeting today and if we're not there, James will never let us hear the end of it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for hanging out, guys.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Yeah, of course. Feel free to enjoy the campus.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: See you two later.
Bryce and $USR head off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something bothering you about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean... I guess... You just... Don't... Usually make jokes.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Um, who is this girl, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's my girlfriend. $ZOE, is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. Everything is fine. Have a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He always makes me laugh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are! Girls, this is my awesome girlfriend, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Girlfriend? Aw... All the good ones are always taken!
Howard leans over and gives $ZOE a kiss!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You smell like muffins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here, try one. I made your favorite, chocolate chip!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Aw, you two are really cute together.
$ZOE freezes!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: So, Howard, what are you doing later?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, Viv! I have a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In fact, she's standing right there.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Great. All the good ones always have girlfriends!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE you were gone for so long! How did the baking go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You tell me. Have a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So... Apparently muffins aren't my strong suit. How about I follow your lead?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Mmmm! These muffins smell great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? That was easy! Now, let's take these out to the rest of the people at the party.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I bet they're starving by now.
$ZOE and Beth head back into the den where they find Howard surrounded by girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that's how we won the game!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I had no idea you were such an athlete, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it's no big deal.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It sounds like you were the star of the team. I'd say that's something to brag about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, $ZOE. Be cool. Don't panic. They're not like, `all over` him...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, $ZOE. Be cool. Don't panic. They're not like, [color=#3b78e2][i]all over[/i][/color] him...

nodes.text: One of the girls laughs and grabs Howard's arm!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee! You're so funny, Howard!

options.label: That's what I love about him.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In particular, you may want to check on the muffins...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, and clean up this entire mess! $ZOE is right, Beth. This kitchen is a wreck!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. And. Um. About those muffins...
Beth runs around the kitchen starting to clean... Suddenly the smoke alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The oven!
$ZOE runs over and turns off the oven. She quickly throws open the window and starts fanning the smoke out!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: This is a disaster! The muffins are ruined!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, baking muffins is easy! I'll help Beth make a new batch in no time.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What? Oh no!
Beth opens the oven, and black smoke pours out!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So much for not burning the muffins this time.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, it's no problem. Things burn all the time. You can always start over. Here, I'll do the muffins this time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And while I'm at it, I can help you get this whole kitchen set up. Keeping it a little cleaner will make baking a lot easier.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. And good catch on the muffins. We could have had a real disaster on our hands.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem!
$ZOE leads Howard around campus...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll see...
Howard sees a familiar face across the quad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, there's $USR!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Over there! Don't you recognize him?

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Howard! Glad you could make it, man!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR, Bryce! It's been too long. Thanks for letting us drop by.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No problem. Flash and I were just hitting up O.M.G.'s Breakfast Bash.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Flash?

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Heh. That's me. Some of the guys call me Flash now.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You should see this guy on the field. He's gotten even better. We can play a pickup game.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Well, there's time for that later. You guys must be hungry.
$USR leads the group to a sorority house just off-campus... College girls are mingling about everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: This is the O.M.G. house. Beth and Paula are both around here somewhere...
$USR spots Beth and waves her over.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! Welcome to O.M.G.'s Breakfast Bash!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great, that's exactly what we need. More free-loaders. Beth, we're trying to throw a party here.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sorry, Tina. I'll get back to work.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And this time, try not to burn the muffins, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, if you guys are baking, maybe I could help.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Really? That... Would be great, actually.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, that would be awesome! Are you sure you want to? We're supposed to be showing you around, not putting you to work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's no trouble. I love baking!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: That's exactly the kind of attitude we need.
Tina grabs $ZOE's hand and pulls her into the kitchen. Beth follows behind.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Here you go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh wow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This kitchen is a complete mess! Is that smoke coming out of the oven?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen a kitchen this messy! It's actually dangerous! But how should I say this? I don't want to insult them, but those muffins are about to ignite!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That may be so, but he and I are not peers.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This insufferable and irritating young man should not address me as anything less than a superior elder.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Superior'? More like `suck`perior!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Superior'? More like [color=#e23b3b][i]suck[/i][/color]perior!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not helping, Hector!
Bertram bristles and turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Kingston Kings know how to address their elders politely and correctly.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And they should know how to pick their friends accordingly.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Come along.
Howard shoots Hector an angry look as he follows Bertram outside.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I fail to see the manner of his respect.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, he thinks Kingston is a fine institution, so he's giving it props.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of like giving it applause.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Is that so? Well, I'm glad even the less eloquent find our school dignified. I'll try not to be insulted.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, good.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I suppose the world has evolved, and language along with it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But I'll grieve the end of the proper salutation later.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Come along, Howard.
Bertram heads outside, but Hector pulls Howard back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey man, sorry about that... I didn't know you were interviewing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem. I think it worked itself out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good luck! Catch you later!
Hector walks back into the restaurant, and Howard follows Bertram outside.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, it was simply splendid!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Howard, do you know this opera?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er... I know what opera is...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Splendid! Would you describe the main singer's voice as dramatic, lyric, or coloratura?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Err... Lyric?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Why do you think that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because she seems `lyric`al?
nodes.text_bbcode: Because she seems [color=#e23b3b][i]lyric[/i][/color]al?

nodes.text: Arthur stares at Howard...
Then bursts into laughter!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Ha ha! Bloomsburg, keep this one around. He is of a cultured background indeed.
They proceed to talk more of music, art, and literature. Finally, at the end of lunch...
Arthur shakes Howard's hand.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I can see you fitting right in at Kingston, young man.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, sir.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Good show, old sport.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I hope we shall meet again.
Arthur moves away from their table.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I've rarely seen him take that warmly to anyone. You must have made a good impression.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Er.... Color-whatever?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No... That's not how I'd describe her at all.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I have to say... I was hoping you'd have more of an appreciation for the opera.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: It's a shame that our youth nowadays has no idea what culture is really about.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It is indeed, sir. It is indeed.
Arthur shoves away from the table and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, I believe I see someone I must mingle with. Carry on.
Arthur strides away.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He left in a hurry. He's usually so talkative.
They eat the rest of their meal in silence. When lunch is over, Bertram stands up.
Howard stands up to follow Bertram out of the lunch hall when he runs into Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Howard... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I, uh, I'm on a date with Amanda. Hey, I'm glad I ran into you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I got an issue...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I were making out in the broom closet of this place...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Which was kind of a bad idea because some janitor totally walked in on us and kicked us out...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...So then we moved things to the girls' bathroom, but there was this incident with the `toilet paper...`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...So then we moved things to the girls' bathroom, but there was this incident with the [color=#e23b3b][i]toilet paper...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard cuts him off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, as much I'd like to help you... I'm a little busy...
Howard jerks his head at Bertram.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, you know this young man?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We went to Twin Branches together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, this man is from `Kingston University.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, this man is from [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston University.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hector puts a hand out for Bertram to shake.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's up, dawg?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: 'Dog'? I see no such mangy creature...
Hector claps Bertram on the back.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, man, I'm talking about you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've heard about your school, College Recruiter Guy. Your college is awesome! Props, man. Serious props.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I beg your pardon! I am no two-bit actor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mr. Bloomsburg, I'm so sorry... This is how he is.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Insulting?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's not insulting you! He's being...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Yes! Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He just said that she was `not` an alto.
nodes.text_bbcode: He just said that she was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] an alto.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No, I remember now! The singer is a soprano.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: No... A contralto has the `lowest` voice.
nodes.text_bbcode: No... A contralto has the [color=#e23b3b][i]lowest[/i][/color] voice.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I remember now! The singer is a soprano.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Speaking of music, I saw an opera at the theater this past weekend. It was one you've been wanting to see.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: 'Orfeo ed Euridice'? Yes! What were your impressions?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I enjoyed the voice of Euridice herself...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: She is an alto?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: No. She sings higher than that. She's...
Arthur turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: You know the term I'm looking for, don't you? A singer who can hit the highest notes?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, you mean a...

nodes.prompt: A singer who hits the highest notes is...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: A singer who hits the highest notes is...

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Indeed! His unfinished masterpiece still haunts me to this day.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: As it does me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, me three... Too!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We are talking of Chopin, not Michelangelo!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Chopin was a great composer!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We are talking of Chopin, not Emerson!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Chopin was a great composer!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He was an inventor, a scientist, a philosopher...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He could do many things!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Which you delineated in your article most eloquently.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Anyway, once I read your paper, it put me in the mood for Chopin.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Another figure of exceptional humanity.
They look over at Howard expectantly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Chopin. He created incredible...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: How pedestrian.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't he paint the, uh, Mona Lisa?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes, of course, but he was so much more than that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Da Vinci was famous for more than just the Mona Lisa, right?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes! I'm happy to see the public school system has raised its standards in the last few years.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: That is insulting!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Da Vinci was not the winner of some paltry fair prize.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe I'm thinking of someone else.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Da Vinci was an incredible man of history!
A short while later, Howard walks Bertram Bloomsburg through this new section of the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I think that overall you've done some good work. The park looks better than it did before!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm kind of impressed, Howard. Everyone responds to your leadership.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This reflects very well on you. This is the kind of initiative we look for in Kings...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you for showing me this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so glad to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know it's, uh, not perfect...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That it is not. In fact, I believe the park looks much worse than it did before...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Your dedication to your community is positive...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But it is important to note that we look for men who can follow through with their promises.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And in this case, I believe you might have let the park down.
Bertram clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: In any case, I think our time here is done. We have a luncheon to get to.
A short drive later...
Bertram leads Howard into the private back room of a fancy restaurant where several people are milling about.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who are all these people?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: These are all representatives from Kingston. I brought you to this luncheon so that you could meet other Kingston Kings.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: All of these men have accomplished great things. There's a geneticist over there who's had a hand in mapping the human genome...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And that man over there is a Nobel Laureate. And the man in tweed over there invented the first canine milking machine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The what?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It's more profitable than you'd think!
Eventually, Bertram leads Howard to a table. They are soon joined by a friendly-looking man.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, this is Arthur Billingsly. He's the Dean of Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Arthur, this is Howard, a potential candidate for our Kingston King program.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: How delightful!

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Bertram, I hope you don't mind catching up a bit.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: I read your paper on the early exploits of Leonardo da Vinci.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The one I wrote in my sophomore year?

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: The very one. And I must say, it's quite brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Of course it is. I wrote it.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: Leonardo da Vinci was truly a Renaissance man.
Arthur turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Arthur
nodes.text: You are familiar with the term?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh... They actually want me to talk about cultural stuff? Here goes nothing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course. A Renaissance man is someone who...

nodes.prompt: A Renaissance man is someone who...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: A Renaissance man is someone who...

nodes.text: Howard grabs a towel from the pile of supplies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're going to take this towel and wipe off what you've written.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hopefully, the paint will just come off straight away.
Howard watches Ryan futilely rub at the spray paint, but it just creates a blur of paint!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Forget it! It's never coming off! And it's just a mess now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me try.
Howard scrubs at the wall, but finds that he can't get the paint off either.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So what now, wise guy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess we just leave it... Hopefully it doesn't ruin the park too much...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: So can I get out of here now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Go.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? How does that make any sense?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you'll probably smear all the paint if you try to wash it off now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And to be honest... What you have isn't actually that bad...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, if you finish it up, maybe people will think it's a mural or something.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I guess it's better than scrubbing it all off.
Ryan finishes up his graffiti, and a mural of abstract shapes stares back at them.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, it looks like it kind of belongs there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right... You're free to go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good work, Ryan. I'll put in a good word with Judge Shao for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh, what?
Howard turns around...
And finds Ryan spray painting a crude drawing of himself directly over the mural!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ryan, what are you doing?! You're supposed to be washing the graffiti off, not putting on more!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I figured if I was going to wash it off anyway, I'd have some fun first.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, `I'm` having fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] having fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Somehow I don't think the judge that gave you community service will agree with you...
Howard studies the wall.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. There's not much time left. Here's what you're going to do. You're going to...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!
They lift the tree together and place it into a freshly dug hole in the ground.
Phil shovels dirt around the tree, anchoring it into place.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That worked! Hey, would you mind helping with this other one over here?
Howard and Phil plant two more trees.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard! I can take it from here...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No problem!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!
Phil lifts, but Howard doesn't!
Phil's force makes him slip and stumble into the grass!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, man... What gives? You didn't lift on three!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope I didn't strain something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Try again?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'll just do it myself.
Phil looks around and sees a shovel. He uses it to get the tree out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, uh, good work, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks. Go check up on someone else now.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
Phil lifts, but Howard doesn't!
Phil's force makes him slip and stumble into the grass!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, man... What gives? You didn't lift on three!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I hope I didn't strain something...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Try again?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'll just do it myself.
Phil looks around and sees a shovel. He uses it to get the tree out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, uh, good work, Phil.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks. Go check up on someone else now.
Howard turns away from them and checks on Phil.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Good. But this one tree's giving me some trouble. It's so heavy that I can't even push it into the hole.
Phil points to a tree with a thick trunk. Howard gives it a pull, but it doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think we can pick the tree up if we try it together.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Great! Let's lift it on three!
They brace themselves around the tree.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: One...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Two...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh... Do I lift on three or after three?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you'll never know who's better unless you try it, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So let's see who can get things done the fastest.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll give you each a section to weed out of, and however many weeds you pull out will determine the winner.
Zach turns to Spencer, his eyes narrowed.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: All right.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And we'll get the work done faster too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zach, you're going to take the flower bed on the right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Spencer, you take the one on the left.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you guys ready?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go!
Zach and Spencer go at it for several minutes, pulling weeds out maniacally.
After a few minutes, the flower beds look visibly better!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great jobs, guys!
Howard glances back to Bertram. He's scribbling on his clipboard, but he's nodding his head.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Never. I'm not sorry for anything!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm only sorry you got in the way.
Spencer lunges at Zach again, and they start trampling the daisies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys!
Howard tries to intervene, but Spencer accidentally hits him hard in the face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ow!
Spencer looks back and pulls away from Zach.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard. But you knew it was coming.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys! Seriously! This is `super` important to me! Can you maybe try and `not` ruin my life?
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys! Seriously! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]super[/i][/color] important to me! Can you maybe try and [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] ruin my life?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Fine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fine![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That could have gone better...
Howard glances back to Bertram. He's scribbling with a frown on his face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well? What should we do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd `love` to hear your advice!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You two should definitely apologize to one another!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember above all that you're `capable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember above all that you're [color=#3b78e2][i]capable.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know what? You're right! And I just thought of something!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know exactly how I can show the Kingston rep that I'm a responsible member of the community.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE, but I'm going to have to spend the rest of the morning putting it together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I understand. I have to get home anyway.
Zoe kisses him on the nose as she rises to leave.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now get to work! And good luck on your interview!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!
As soon as $ZOE leaves, Howard reaches for his phone...
Later that afternoon, Howard enters the park and finds a man in a business suit waiting with a clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You must be Howard. I'm Bertram Bloomsburg IV, former Kingston King and regional representative for Kingston University.
Bertram holds out his hand which Howard shakes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's nice to meet you. Thanks for coming here.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I will admit that I was surprised by your request to meet in the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Normally, I like to converse with prospective candidates about their resume...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And of course, I'm happy to answer any questions about my resume, but I brought you here to show you what I can achieve.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Being a Kingston King means having a civic responsibility, a duty to your community.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Indeed.
Bertram scribbles something on his clipboard, but Howard can't make it out.
Nervously, Howard brings Bertram over to a group of guys huddled in the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mr. Bloomsburg, these are friends that I called this morning for a community service project to beautify the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Interesting. We only just spoke yesterday. How did you manage to plan all this so quickly?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It helps being the captain of the football team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I figured you would appreciate seeing my leadership skills in action.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you don't mind staying here and watching, it'll only be an hour or so.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Proceed. I find myself most intrigued.
Howard goes over to the group and starts talking.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, guys. Huddle up! Thanks for being here for me. This is what your community service is going to entail.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zach, Spencer, you're in charge of the weeding over there by the sandbox.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Weeding?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh man...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Phil, you're going to be standing up some trees.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's like Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And what about me? What do `I` do?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what about me? What do [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ryan?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That stupid judge says I have to do mandatory community service, so he assigned me to clean up the park!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way. Nuh-uh. Not after what you did at my last interview.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Look, man, getting into a fight with you was a bad call. I'm sorry about that. But I'm stuck here, and that means you're stuck with me!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! I know! Maybe I could go help by that gazebo!
Ryan points to the gazebo where a couple of cute girls are talking in the shade of its eaves.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, not gonna happen. Why don't you go clean the graffiti off that wall instead?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Weak! Mandatory community service blows!
Bertram and Howard walk around while the boys beautify the park.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: How long have you been the captain of the football team?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For a couple years now. It's a really great team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the guys are really good for work like this.
Howard watches over the football players when suddenly there's a large commotion in the garden.
Howard runs over to find Zach and Spencer pushing one another.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys... Break it up!
Howard separates the two of them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's going on here? You two are supposed to be working together, not fighting.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: He's the one who started it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, maybe I wouldn't have started it if it wasn't for your stupid face!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You're the one with the stupid face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not anyone's stupid face. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spencer was bragging about how he was way better at working than I am...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So I pushed him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, except that before I did that... He was telling me what a loser I am!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It sounds like you two need to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's an important quality in a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But do you think it's enough to be honest?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course it is. Sometimes being honest is the hardest thing in the world to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's an admirable quality.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even more than being honest...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's an important quality in a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But do you think it's enough to be smart?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course it is. We need smart leaders who can predict what's going to happen in the future.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kingston will love you for that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even more than being smart...

nodes.title: A Kingston King
nodes.subtitle: Can Howard prove he's worthy of Kingston?

nodes.text: It's the morning of Howard's interview with Kingston University, and Zoe is talking with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how are you holding up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so glad that Kingston's decided to give me another chance to get in, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm nervous about this interview. There's just a huge knot where my stomach used to be.
$ZOE pats him on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's hard, but you can do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were prepared for the last interview, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I was. But this is going to be nothing like the last interview.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What's different?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, last time, I was qualifying for a football scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My interviewer wasn't going to ask me any hard questions about what I want to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their `Kingston Kings` leadership program.
nodes.text_bbcode: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston Kings[/i][/color] leadership program.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Kingston Kings are the elite leaders of the school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're involved in almost everything, and they usually go on to become prestigious politicians or super rich businessmen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I want to go to Kingston, I have to prove I'm going to be a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all just too much, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, that does sound intense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you're anxious, but you're going to do fine! You're a wonderful guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, but unfortunately 'good boyfriend' isn't one of the qualities they're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are they looking for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I was preparing for the interview, I found some materials that classify Kingston Kings as men of civic responsibility, culture, and honor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's good. You `are` all those things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's good. You [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] all those things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But can I prove that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you can't go into an interview thinking like that! Come on, say one nice thing about yourself before you start...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'm...

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I believe you are someone who has a clear vision of what you are looking for in a school.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And you're someone who I believe will go on to do great things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad I gave that impression.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm not entirely convinced you have your priorities in order.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And I'm not confident that you know exactly what you want to do with your life.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You certainly don't always communicate that with your words and actions.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I really blew the interview, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: It wasn't your best effort.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... Did I get in?
Bertram heaves a large sigh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I have to weigh all the pros and cons of each candidate.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Last time you were interviewed, we had to cancel it because you got into a fight.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now, I know that wasn't your fault, but we have to be very careful of who we choose to be at Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not everyone has that special spark that is required and expected of a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well... I'm saying that you might not have that spark.
At that moment, they come across the football bleachers, and $ZOE runs up to them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, good! You're just in time! Come over here!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, what is this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess it's something my girlfriend pulled together.
$ZOE leads them to the front of the football field where a large crowd of people are sitting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... What exactly is going on? Where are you taking me and Mr. Bloomsburg?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I thought it might help Mr. Bloomsburg's decision to hear just what kind of person you are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I brought together every student in our school who's gotten to know Howard over the years...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's hear what they have to say!
Zoe starts passing the mic around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What makes me a Kingston King is that I'm honest.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They always say that honesty is the best policy, and I always tell the truth.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not to discount your best quality...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But many of our candidates are equally honest, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But honesty is a fine quality in a young man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Does that mean I got in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What makes me a Kingston King is that I'm smart.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm always thinking up new projects and figuring out problems.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not to discount that quality, but...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We have many smart candidates applying for the position.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But don't let what I said go to your head. We wouldn't be interviewing you if we didn't believe you had potential.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Did I get in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have many strengths, but I think my greatest one is that I'm capable.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Care to explain what that means exactly?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I want to do something big with my life.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I believe I have the resources and means to get everything I want out of it.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That is an important quality, and one I'd like to see in more of your generation.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Does that mean I got in?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You know what? Nevermind!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Did I get in?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This brings me to my last question...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why do you think that `you` are the strongest candidate to be a Kingston King?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do you think that [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are the strongest candidate to be a Kingston King?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I must say, I'm surprised. Most people choose famous figures, influential people who inspire.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My girlfriend is an inspiration.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's always there to support me, she's kind and generous, and she makes me want to be a better man.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well said, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why are your sisters your inspiration?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're little troublemakers. They're always making a name for themselves in all their classes with their pranks and jokes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My mom used to get so many calls from their terrified teachers over the years. It was pretty intense.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You want to be a troublemaker, known only for your infamy?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I just meant that I didn't want to lose my sense of humor, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When you say it like that, it sounds bad.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Indeed.
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Who is Mr. Doom?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, he's an urban legend. He's this grotesque, disfigured creature who used to live in the woods!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why on earth is he someone who's influential in your life?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He used to terrorize all the Twin Branches kids. We'd never venture in the woods at night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd say that's pretty influential...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I see.
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.
Howard just gapes at Bertram. He is unable to say anything.
The silence stretches long and awkward between them.
Eventually, Bertram clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Let's move on, shall we?
Bertram looks down at his notes and makes a red checkmark on his paper.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
