nodes.text: Next question... Tell me who has been the most influential person in your life.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I know you were previously interviewed for the football scholarship..

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But surely you want to attend Kingston for more than just its `sports` team.
nodes.text_bbcode: But surely you want to attend Kingston for more than just its [color=#e23b3b][i]sports[/i][/color] team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course I do, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Football is the first thing that popped into my head.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I visited Centerscore University a short time ago.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I found I was very interested in their sports medicine program.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But they didn't have enough classes to support it as a major.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They told me Kingston's program is supposed to be one of the best ones, and that's what I want to study.
Bertram smiles and nods as he jots down notes on his clipboard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I beg your pardon?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, Kingston really sounds like a fun school to go to.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Kingston is not a party school!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I hope you know that Kingston prides itself on its cultural and academic experience.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not on the level of enjoyment one derives from its parties.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, well, that's only one reason why I'd like to go there.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But apparently it is the only one that matters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Um...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should I have a good reason?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I should hope so.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The point and the match are `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The point and the match are [color=#e23b3b][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bertram bows curtly to Howard, and Howard returns the awkward gesture.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Not exactly your finest hour, was it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Still, you `did` hold your own for a while there...
nodes.text_bbcode: Still, you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] hold your own for a while there...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And you may yet prove yourself to be Kingston material in other arenas...
The tip of his foil scrapes against Bertram's cheek, putting a red welt across his face!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Ahh!` My stately, handsome face! Illegal hit!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color] My stately, handsome face! Illegal hit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am `so` sorry... I don't normally go around giving people welts!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] sorry... I don't normally go around giving people welts!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: No matter.
Howard drives the tip of his foil against Bertram's chest!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact. The point and the match are yours!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well fought!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, sir.
Howard jabs the tip of his foil against Bertram's unprotected thighs slicing off his pants below the knees!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Ahh!` You've given me knickers! Illegal hit!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color] You've given me knickers! Illegal hit!

nodes.text: Bertram and Howard line up again, trading attacks, parries, and ripostes until the score is two to two.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Well, it seems we're even. It all comes down to this!
Bertram and Howard tap blades! Immediately, Bertram goes on the offensive. He feints to the side and thrusts!
Howard parries the attack and then ripostes, driving the tip of his foil straight toward Bertram's...
Howard jabs! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Bertram's chest before he can steady himself!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...UFF![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact! Well done, Howard! The point is `yours.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Contact! Well done, Howard! The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]yours.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I did it!
Howard jerks his foil to the side, but parries empty air! Bertram seizes the blunder and thrusts!
The blunted tip of his foil pokes Howard's chest!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... My point!
Howard hesitates!
As if in slow motion, he can see Bertram advance...
He moves to parry, but hits empty air! Bertram seizes the blunder and thrusts!
The blunted tip of his foil pokes Howard's chest!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... My point!
Bertram and Howard return to the center of the mat. They tap their blades to signal the start of the point...
Bertram hops deftly back. He feints forward and, for one instant, is off balance! Howard quickly...
Howard levels his blade to jab, but Bertram is faster! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Howard in the chest before he can even move!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... The point is `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Contact... The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard jerks his foil, batting the tip of Bertram's blade harmlessly to the side!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha!
Bertram stumbles forward, and his momentum carries him off the edge of the mat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Skillful deflection, Howard. The point is `yours.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Skillful deflection, Howard. The point is [color=#e23b3b][i]yours.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Uncertain what to do, Howard attacks!
He levels his blade to jab, but Bertram is faster! The blunted tip of the foil pokes Howard in the chest before he can even move!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Contact... The point is `mine.`

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Given that you've never fenced before, I'll clarify the rules...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now let us adjourn to the `piste.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now let us adjourn to the [color=#e23b3b][i]piste.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, okay... I guess I did have a bunch of glasses of water with lunch.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The `piste` is the mat that we will fence upon!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]piste[/i][/color] is the mat that we will fence upon!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That makes more sense... Especially since I can't locate the zipper on this jacket thing.
Howard and Bertram take position at the middle of a long mat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Never...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm hoping that fencing skills aren't a requirement for the scholarship... I just don't want to lie.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Thank you for being honest with me, Howard...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's better than being skewered in a fight...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: The sad truth is that these days, most of our students have never felt the thrill of wielding a supple blade.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I don't have to fence...?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: On the contrary, you absolutely must! But I will assess you based on your promise, not your skill.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Too small...? The fit `seems` all right to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Too small...? The fit [color=#e23b3b][i]seems[/i][/color] all right to me.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But if you know enough to properly evaluate the fit of your safety equipment, you must have some experience fencing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, but...
Bertram scurries back over to the rack and returns with a larger jacket.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are.
Howard puts the jacket on. The collar hangs loose around his throat, and the sleeves dangle several inches below his hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This... This is perfect.
They walk a short distance from the restaurant to a large building.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This way, this way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, where are we going?
Bertram flips a switch on the wall. There is a chunk-chunk sound as banks of lights turn on revealing an open area with a long mat.
Along the walls are racks filled with gleaming foils, epees, and rapiers.
And just ahead are practice dummies wearing padded white jackets and wire-mesh masks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Any prospective Kingston man must demonstrate proficiency at 'the sport of gentlemanly pokes'...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... That sounds kind of...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Fencing...` The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is `fencing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fencing...[/i][/color] The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is [color=#e23b3b][i]fencing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, `wow,` that is a relief...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]wow,[/i][/color] that is a relief...

nodes.text: Betram steps over to the practice dummies and retrieves two white fencing jackets. He offers one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are. Now put this on.
Howard struggles into the padded jacket, wrestling with the straps to secure it into place.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: What's the matter, Howard? You have put on fencing attire before, have you not?
Inside the aquatic center...
The group walks to the hot tub at the side of the large pool.
Jane, Amanda, and Lee wade to the hottest part and soak happily.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ahh... This is the life...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Made all the better by the fact that no one else is here...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It's like being home.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your home must be really sweaty!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Something like that. I just meant that we have a set up like this.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No surprise... Of course a mansion like yours probably has a hot tub.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: If by 'hot tub', you mean 'bathhouse', then you'd be right...
In another part of the tub, Hannah and Zach sit close to one another.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So then I told the monkey... 'Get that banana, or I'm going to ban-at-ya!'

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Zach, that doesn't even make sense! It was so bad!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So bad that it's awesome?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, not that either. But you're cute enough to get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
Near the stairs of the tub, Sara and Cameron sit alone.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So... How does it feel to not follow your dad's orders for once?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's mostly nice... But I still feel guilty...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why? It's not like you're doing anything `bad.` What, he really cares that you're out eating junk food at midnight?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why? It's not like you're doing anything [color=#e23b3b][i]bad.[/i][/color] What, he really cares that you're out eating junk food at midnight?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad is invested in my career. He likes looking out for me.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Giving you a home, food, and some love is 'looking out for you'.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Dictating your entire diet, your sleeping schedule, and your social life is not.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad is not a villain.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Really? So you've never given up on something because he wouldn't approve?
Sara looks away, thinking of Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He's my dad. Shouldn't I listen to him?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Maybe you should listen to yourself first.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Think about what you would do if you could make up your own mind.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You might be right...
She looks down.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sorry if I hit a nerve. You've been kind of out of it lately, especially at practice.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was wondering if it had something to do with your strict schedule. Like you're putting too much pressure on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So what's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know if I can tell you.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh wait, I get it... You don't trust me because you think I'm some kind of bad boy...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ha ha. That's not exactly it.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: But you were thinking something like it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're a total heartbreaker, Cameron... You're the kind of guy that girls fall for but can never trust.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You think girls really fall for me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know they do. You have 'Pay attention to me' written all over you. Girls notice.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well, maybe I don't want `their` attention.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe I don't want [color=#e23b3b][i]their[/i][/color] attention.

nodes.text: He looks deeply into Sara's eyes. She can feel her cheeks heat up.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All the girls say Cameron's hot... But I never really thought about it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So why am I now?!
Cameron nudges her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I hope you know that you can trust me. With anything.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Should I tell him about Nick and everything that's been going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, everyone...
After school, the cheerleaders hide near Matteo's scooter...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's coming!
When Matteo nears, they jump out of their hiding spot!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yah! Pretty scooter thieves! Wait... What is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's your personal cheer! One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Did you have a tough day? Don't worry, that's okay! {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { You should never feel gray-o, when your name is Matteo! {
$ZOE stops when she realizes that none of the other cheerleaders are following her lead...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Girls?
$ZOE looks back at the cheerleaders. They're gathered around Jill. She's on the ground, holding her stomach and groaning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Unnh! So much food!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Actually, my stomach's been upset all day too...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Blech. I ate two pizzas `today...` $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.
nodes.text_bbcode: Blech. I ate two pizzas [color=#e23b3b][i]today...[/i][/color] $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh! I think my new No Diet diet might be at fault here... The cheerleaders aren't able to regulate themselves!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: May I please drive my vehicle away?
Just then, $ZOE feels a tapping on her shoulder... She turns to face...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: In my office, right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
A few moments later, in the principal's office...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it, Principal Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm very concerned.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Cheerleading is a long-standing institution, $ZOE. I've seen more shifts in power than you can count.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Every once in a while, a sweet, nice girl like you takes over... And every time it's the same thing...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The sweet, nice girl tries to turn cheerleading into a democracy, and the other cheerleaders walk all over her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the girls haven't been walking all over me!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: They haven't?! This morning, I got called into Mr. Russell's class... The girls were doing backflips for Phil just because he lit his own Bunsen burner!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And this kind of disruption is just the tip of the iceberg... The nurse's office has been a revolving door of cheerleaders with upset stomachs!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, I `will cancel cheerleading!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, I [color=#3b78e2][i]will cancel cheerleading![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I can't? Dear, I'm the principal. I can do what I want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's so unfair! Cheerleading is important! It boosts team spirit!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Then you're going to have to do something about it, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now tell me what you're going to do to get those girls under your control.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's not that I don't like the Lizard suit... I love it! Every time I put this scaly suit on, my blood tingles with school pride, team spirit, and lizard energies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But it's hotter than a hot dog on Sunday in this thing, and I have notoriously sweaty glands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik's so sweet... But if I let him start wearing something else, he'll never wear the mascot suit again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Erik... You have to wear the suit... It's...

nodes.prompt: You have to wear the suit... It's...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You have to wear the suit... It's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, the rally is today... Do you think you'll be ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
At the big rally, Principal Shapiro stands onstage behind a podium in front of the school...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Welcome, everyone to this monumental event.
The audience claps.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Two months ago, our school was rocked by an earthquake. Fortunately, no one was killed, and nearly everyone escaped unharmed...
As Principal Shapiro speaks, the cheerleaders gather near the stage...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Where's $ZOE? We're about to go on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I haven't seen her...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There she is!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why does she look so scary?!
$ZOE leaps onto the stage, storms across, and slams a stereo onto a nearby bench!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is boring, Principal Whatever Your Name Is!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Excuse me?
$ZOE wrests the microphone away from Shapiro.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone, listen up! From now on, we're going to do things `my` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone, listen up! From now on, we're going to do things [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] way!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Duh! Yes, it's me! Is something surprising, Maria?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just seem so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Was I talking to you, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Angry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nerds! Light some fireworks!
Pyrotechnics light the stage! $ZOE plays some music on the stereo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Audience! Start dancing!
No one moves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dance, or I'll make you dance!
The audience hesitantly begins to dance...
$ZOE dances on a nearby table!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo! Party! All right!
She sees the cheerleaders standing still onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing? Get into the pyramid now! Hector on the bottom!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What happened to the line?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those days are over with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Totes` over with!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over with!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders begrudgingly get into pyramid formation...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is Jessica back but in $ZOE's body?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think so, Amanda...
Months later...
$ZOE hands out flyers to students as they walk down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be `totes` epic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] epic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Attendance `is` mandatory, so if you don't come...
nodes.text_bbcode: Attendance [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] mandatory, so if you don't come...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be `super` disappointed!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How did you get Howard to be President of the high school when he's in college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't ask stupid questions, Maria! There's still some room at the bottom of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE, why are you doing this? You're not like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am `now,` Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow, Howie and I are going to be yachting in the bay with a Senator...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got to look my best... And that means cutting a few programs from the school budget!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I really like the new $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you do! What's not to like?! I'm `so` the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you do! What's not to like?! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] the best!

nodes.text: Oh no! This can't be the Good Ending! Not with $ZOE acting exactly like Jessica!
You `have` to play again and make this right!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [b]have[/b] to play again and make this right!

nodes.text: See if you can get $ZOE to the big rally!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Behind me is the new school, redone in the image of the old one, but with a few minor tweaks...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: We are no longer the Centerscore Lizards... We are, from now on, the Twin Branches Squirrels!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Squirrels?! That's going to take some getting used to...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Crazy! I don't know about you guys, but I'm Lizard through and through.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Does that mean I have to wear a squirrel suit? Because that sounds `really` furry and `really` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Does that mean I have to wear a squirrel suit? Because that sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] furry and [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Settle down... I know the new name will take some getting used to...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: To commemorate this moment, I've asked the cheerleaders to perform! They'll be doing so under the guidance of their new Head Cheerleader, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can do it, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go Squirrels!
Some of the students look at Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just thought I'd give the new name a spin...
$ZOE and the cheerleaders take the stage... They line up in a tight, crisp formation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ready, okay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Things were good, things were great! {

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { Then we got hit by a big earthquake! {

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: { Times were tough, times were rotten! {

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { But we are Lizards, er... Squirrels... Or have you forgotten?! {

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: { We've rebuilt the school, a place for learning... {

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: { Fun, and young romances... {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { Yay! Yay! Yay! Twin Branches! {
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Time for the stunt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! What stunt?
The cheerleaders cradle Amanda in their arms...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Three...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Two...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: One...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleaders stop an instant before throwing Amanda into the air.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you guys doing?! This is really dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's just a stunt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A stunt you didn't run by me first...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Because you probably would have said 'no.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, because it involves tossing and catching Amanda on a tiny, rickety stage!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! That could have hurt!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry...
The crowd starts to boo. $ZOE eyes the podium and strides over to it. She taps on the microphone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Hello, Twin Branches.
The crowd quiets...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you're upset because you didn't get to see a stunt, but what you just saw was actually a scary moment. Thankfully, Amanda's okay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: These cheerleaders are my responsibility... And if I can't keep them in control, then I'm not doing a very good job.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The truth is... I'm not meant to be a Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't have the kind of personality that's assertive non-stop... It's too much work. And half the time, I just end up feeling mean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not the kind of person I want to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'd like to announce that I'm stepping down as Head Cheerleader...
A murmur of shock ripples through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If you're not Head Cheerleader, who is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Amanda... I just know `definitively` that it isn't me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, Amanda... I just know [color=#3b78e2][i]definitively[/i][/color] that it isn't me.

nodes.text: Wow! $ZOE stepped down from the Head Cheerleader position! Who will fill the void she's left behind?
Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!
In the meantime, you played a great game! You were able to help $ZOE step up to the challenge of being Head Cheerleader!
And even though it wasn't the position for her, she learned a valuable lesson about herself. Congratulations!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How are things between you and Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you two used to date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... That was kind of a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Things didn't work out, but I think we're still pretty good friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He means well, but he can be a little overwhelming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When I almost canceled this date, he told me how much you were looking forward to it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He said that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's funny. Because he said the same thing when I wanted to cancel.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha. Spencer really wanted to get us together, didn't he?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's nice of him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He can be so overprotective. Did you know that he almost beat up Nick when the breakup happened?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No. But I wouldn't put it past him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mind if I ask you a question?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go for it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What really happened between you and Nick?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why would you ask that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, there were so many rumors flying around... It's hard to make sense of it all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... Well...
Sam stays quiet for a long pause.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't push her...
A little while later, Hector pulls off the expressway onto the Twin Branches side of town...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, guys... I think we're officially in the clear!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was `so` awesome! Did you guys see Alexei's face?
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] awesome! Did you guys see Alexei's face?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And what about Steve? 'Rabid reptiles! Rabid reptiles!' Classic!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Thanks, Howard, for suggesting we do a prank! That was `exactly` what we needed!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Thanks, Howard, for suggesting we do a prank! That was [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we needed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... It was pretty great...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: They'll strike back, you know. No way they let us off the hook for that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And we'll be there to stop them!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah we will, Samurai!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh... Thanks, Renegade.
Howard leans forward and pats the guys on the shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Take care of the school when I'm gone, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course, Howard! You know we're on it!
Hector looks at Howard curiously...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man... You okay? I know I gave you some grief earlier, but if you're feeling down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Naw. I'm good. Really.
Howard's phone buzzes. He glances down to see another text from $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Text
nodes.text: Poke? Where r u, Howard? Plz call me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should really text back...
Howard starts to write... When he sees something outside the car!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Stop! Pull over!
Hector pulls the car over alongside the Twin Branches football field.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. I'll catch up with you guys later. You gonna be at $Scott's party?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then I'll see you there!
Hector and Ben drive off. Howard walks onto the football field...
Where a bunch of the players are tossing a ball back and forth!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! What are you guys doing?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What up, Captain? We're just horsing around...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nothing wrong with a little practice in the off-season, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about we do one better?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A practice game. Right now.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You serious?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not? This is my last day at Twin Branches... The last time I'll ever play on this field... Might as well be with my boys, right?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! Let's do it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll take half these guys. Spencer, you wanna captain the other half?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know I'm down... But I kinda feel bad.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, do you `really` want your last memory of playing high school football to be me crushing you?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, do you [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] want your last memory of playing high school football to be me crushing you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it is on...
The guys split into teams and take positions on opposite ends of the field...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's do this!
All the guys start cheering. Howard walks to the edge of the field, where he looks out at it one last time...
And then he walks away.
Later that night...
Howard loiters around at $Scott's party. All around him, people are having fun. The nerds crowd by the TV, playing a video game...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh come on! That's so cheap!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry! Was the goal `not` to hit you with my fireball? Because I thought, you know, you're an ice warrior, I should maybe hit you with a fireball...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'm sorry! Was the goal [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to hit you with my fireball? Because I thought, you know, you're an ice warrior, I should maybe hit you with a fireball...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Brendan brings up a compelling point, Dex!
By the door, $Scott and Angie look out at everything that's going on...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great party, $Scott! I'd say this is definitely one for the history books!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, it's pretty great... I just wish I didn't have to do community service tomorrow morning!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I mean, we missed a bunch of days of school because of the earthquake, so I have to spend my Saturdays cleaning up the park? How does `that` make sense?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, we missed a bunch of days of school because of the earthquake, so I have to spend my Saturdays cleaning up the park? How does [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] make sense?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, just be grateful! We seniors just have to do community service... All the underclassmen have to attend summer school!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, yeah... Sucks to be them!
At the other end of the room, the popular crowd is hanging out...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So what happened next, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone started screaming, that's what! And this guy, Steve, he's all 'Rabid reptiles! Rabid reptiles!'

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Does no one care that I'm dancing on a table?!
Watching it all, Howard sighs to himself...
And then notices someone standing next to him.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda! Hey! It's... It's been a while.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah. It really has.
Linda stands alongside Howard and looks out at the party with him...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You gonna miss this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: More than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was kind of ready for high school to be done, you know? I thought I was ready to move on...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But now... I suddenly wish I had more time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All I can think about is choices I would have made differently... How things might have turned out...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What happened with you and me... With Kenji... I... I'm...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Shh. Don't worry about it. It's all water under the bridge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I promise. And I'm sure you'll have a great time in college.
Howard gives Linda a hug. She smiles and hugs back.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know... We had a pretty good run, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean... If you think about how boring most high schools are... And then some of the adventures `we've` been on...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... If you think about how boring most high schools are... And then some of the adventures [color=#3b78e2][i]we've[/i][/color] been on...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I can't really complain, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. I guess.
Howard turns away from Linda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm gonna go get some fresh air.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course. Take care of yourself, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You too, Linda. You too.
Howard steps out into the backyard. He stares up at the stars overhead...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Goodbye, Twin Branches.
Just then, the gate at the end of the yard swings open.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! $ZOE! Your text! I totally forgot!
$ZOE runs over...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on, Howard? I've been trying to reach you all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, it's just been... A pretty crazy day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, I heard. Something about pranking Wilson and a football game?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's... Complicated...
$ZOE takes Howard's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, what is going on? You can talk to me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just... I woke up this morning, and I realized that I wasn't ready for high school to end!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I decided to have one last great day. That's why we pranked Wilson and why I played football and...
$ZOE looks down, crest-fallen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You decided to have one last  great day of high school... And that didn't involve me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? No! I... I didn't even think of it like that! I... I...
Howard stammers for words... And suddenly, the truth hits him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Gasp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gasp![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get it now! I finally get it! The answer I was looking for all day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't see you today, $ZOE, because I'm not ready to say goodbye to you... And I'm `not` ready to say goodbye to high school!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't see you today, $ZOE, because I'm not ready to say goodbye to you... And I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] ready to say goodbye to high school!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I need to stay back another year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's perfect! I could prank Wilson again... Play more high school football... Take more classes, and you `know` they'd be easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's perfect! I could prank Wilson again... Play more high school football... Take more classes, and you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] they'd be easy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you and I wouldn't have to break up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, please, you're confusing me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even if I humored this ridiculous idea, you `can't` stay back another year! You graduate tomorrow!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I humored this ridiculous idea, you [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] stay back another year! You graduate tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or do I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! You do!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or... `Do I?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... [color=#e23b3b][i]Do I?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Later that night, a half-dozen fire trucks are stationed around the newly rebuilt Twin Branches campus, putting out a small fire. Howard stands to the side...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Howard! What on earth were you thinking, breaking into the school so you could play with fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guess I'm just careless and irresponsible like that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: In light of this disciplinary breach, there's no way I can allow you to graduate...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And since the fire `somehow` only destroyed my academic transcript for the last year...
nodes.text_bbcode: And since the fire [color=#e23b3b][i]somehow[/i][/color] only destroyed my academic transcript for the last year...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm afraid you'll have to retake your senior year!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! Whatever will I do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guess I'll just have to keep coming to this school and having more great memories! What a tragedy!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: ...Why are you talking like that? And why do you keep smiling?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just so wacky and crazy?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, whatever the reason, you won't be coming back to `this` school under any circumstance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, whatever the reason, you won't be coming back to [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] school under any circumstance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Burning school property is a tremendous offense, Howard! You're officially expelled from Twin Branches High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But you said I need to retake senior year...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Yes! You do! And you will...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: At whatever other school will take you!
And so... That September... Howard strolls onto his first day of school...
At Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just lay low... Don't make eye-contact... No one will recognize me...
Howard walks with his head low. All around, people glare at him...
And then a hand grabs his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey! You're that punk that pranked graduation last year!
A crowd of Wilson guys circles around Howard, rolling up their sleeves and cracking their knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it too late to play the comical misunderstanding card?

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Oh yeah.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aiiiiieeeeee!
Howard wasn't ready to move on from high school... But this can't be what he had in mind!
Try again, and see if you get him a happier ending!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I get it! I finally get it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get what, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why I keep feeling the way I do! I've spent all day doing awesome stuff, but it still didn't feel like the right way to say goodbye...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's not high school I'm afraid of saying goodbye to. It's you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm okay having one last prank or one last game or one last drink of water at the good fountain... But I can't even begin to think about having one last date with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Howard... You don't have to. We're `not` breaking up.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Howard... You don't have to. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] breaking up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but... I think I'm terrified of losing you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What if it doesn't work out? What if Centerscore U is too far? What if you meet someone else?
Howard turns away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me `so much.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me [color=#e23b3b][i]so much.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...
$ZOE leans forward and hugs Howard from behind, pressing her face against his back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You won't lose me. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're `perfect` for each other. We're meant to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] for each other. We're meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll never have to say goodbye. Just 'see you soon.'
Howard turns back to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I promise.
Howard leans down and gives $ZOE a long, tender kiss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too.
Wow! Looks like Howard finally figured out what his dream was trying to tell him... And he got the closure he needed! Great job!
Far away, out on the beach, he sees the students of Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Justin! Hey, man! Get over here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The party is on, dude!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're roasting marshmallows!
Behind them, the Splat-A-Pult silently drifts through the water, manned by Steph from Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm too late!
Justin sprints toward them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! Look out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Justin really wants a marshmallow.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's weird like that.
Steph aims the Splat-A-Pult, releases a lever, and sends a gigantic orb of paint high into the air...
Justin stops in his tracks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... I guess he doesn't want a marshmallow...
The orb crashes down on the students, sending them sprawling!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `AAAAHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AAAAHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `OOF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]OOF![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `UHF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]UHF![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Another orb arcs through the sky and splatters over the cheerleaders, drenching them in a bright array of colored paint!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `NOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `EWWW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]EWWW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Yay! I'm a rainbow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yay! I'm a rainbow![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Another one hits the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Accck!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Accck![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We don't have any Protection from Paint gear!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: 4th of July is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie... No...
Soon, the students flee from the beach, past Justin, and into the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Wait! It's a trap!
But now no one will listen. He was too late to warn them of the Splat-A-Pult...
And now, it's too late to warn them of the Wilson elites waiting for them in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Payback time, suckers!
He closes his eyes and buries his head in his hands... Unable to drown out the sound of the students' cries...
Or the feeling of tremendous guilt welling up inside him...
Well, you might have figured it out, but this was definitely `not` the ending Justin wanted!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you might have figured it out, but this was definitely [b]not[/b] the ending Justin wanted!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can get to the beach in time to warn the students before Wilson High strikes!
Justin sees the different cliques of Twin Branches, all hanging out near a large bonfire...
The popular kids...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What else can we throw on this fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean besides these perfect hot dogs?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or these fluffy marshmallows?
The swim team...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'd love to go out for a swim...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, and freeze to death!
The rebels...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know... Girls, bikinis, fire! Seems cool to me!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If we get really bored, I brought the water cannon from last year!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Seriously?
Kenji nods at a large object hidden under a tarp in the back of his truck.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This just got a lot more interesting...
Justin runs up to Angie, who's hanging out with the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, what's wrong? You look like you've seen a ghost?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not too late... I have to warn you...
Justin raises his voice so everyone can hear...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wilson is coming! They've got a catapult that fires paint! They're coming for revenge!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I saw it with my own eyes. They'll be here any second!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, we'll be waiting...
A few minutes later, Twin Branches students are posted at every entrance to the parking lot above the beach...
Behind the main entrance, the rebels point the massive barrel of the water cannon...
Howard pats Justin on the back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good job, man. When they get here, they're in for the shock of their lives!
A few minutes pass...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, everyone! They'll be here!
A few more minutes... The students begin to grow impatient...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where are they?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just, you know, be patient...
Ten minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, is this some kind of weird Justin prank? 'Cause they're not coming, man!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I swear, it's not a prank! They'll be here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you can man the gate, then!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `I'm` going to go get my party on!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to go get my party on!

nodes.text: Hector runs down to the bonfire! Soon, everyone follows...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin... It looks like you were wrong...
Then, over Howard's shoulder, far away on a point jutting out into the water, Justin sees Erik, riding a horse along the shore and waving the two glowsticks from the gift bag!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What the...
Howard turns.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that Erik? On a horse?!
Realization sweeps over Justin like a cascade of water!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Two if by sea!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Two glowsticks! Two lanterns! Wilson isn't coming by land! They're coming by sea!
Justin points out to the water, where the Splat-A-Pult can be seen on a boat drifting silently toward the beach...
Manning the craft are the Wilson elites!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Come on!
Justin and Howard run down and warn everyone!
A minute later, the water cannon is pointed out to sea!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And... Fire!
The cannon blasts a rushing force of water out to sea, shattering the catapult, and spilling paint all over the Wilson elites!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Uck!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uck![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `Grr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: `Ew!` Only my hair is supposed to be blue!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ew![/i][/color] Only my hair is supposed to be blue!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: This wasn't the plan, was it?
Before the cannon fires another shot, Wilson retreats!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We did it!
The students let out a cheer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who wants to celebrate and shoot off some fireworks?!
As the students rally around Howard and his fireworks, Erik runs past Justin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fireworks! Come on, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... No, thanks, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Tonight was `awesome,` wasn't it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tonight was [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome,[/i][/color] wasn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You really came through... What made you decide to come back? And how'd you know Wilson was coming from the ocean?
Erik pats Justin on the shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho, boy, what a story! I'll tell you later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But right now, it's fireworks time!
Erik scampers off toward the fireworks...
Justin walks along the beach, a lonely look on his face...
Angie walks beside him...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hi, Angie. Where's $Scott? I figured this kind of party would be his thing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He had to pick up some equipment for his backpacking trip...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh... Right. I'm sorry about you two. I heard about how you're going to break up at the end of summer...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Must be hard.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It hasn't been my favorite time of year.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway, you're kind of the hero, today, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I guess... Heh.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What's funny?
Justin stops, looking out at the dark ocean.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I thought that I wanted to be the hero. That if I did something like this as my last Presidential act, everyone would be my friend.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, there's your opportunity...
Angie nods to the cool kids, who are off playing with fireworks, calling and waving for Justin to join them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, but, uh, I was wrong. That isn't what I want.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It isn't? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I want you, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, I'm with...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, just... Just let me finish.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I want you, but I'm not asking anything of you. You're with $Scott... And I know that...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I see everyone graduating, and I know that there isn't much time left... I can't be passive anymore.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So... There, I said it. I like you, and you're beautiful, and I understand if you don't want talk to me ever again. Goodbye.
Justin walks off...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin! Wait!
Angie runs over to him and kisses him lightly on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Never thought I'd do that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For being brave.
He smiles...
Wow! You helped Justin warn Twin Branches in time, and as a result, he helped repel the Wilson attack!
Even more, you helped him express his feelings for Angie...
What that will mean only time will tell... For now...
`Congratulations! You played a great game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Congratulations! You played a great game![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right! I totally forgot! Stay right here...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry, as long as I'm as far away from Sara and Nick as possible, I'm not going anywhere.
$ZOE heads over toward Howard, who's hanging with a group of guys...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And why have I only eaten celery sticks at this party?!
Back on the mainland, Ben and Colt and their new swine friend arrive at the beach parking lot `just` as the second ferry sails off!
nodes.text_bbcode: Back on the mainland, Ben and Colt and their new swine friend arrive at the beach parking lot [b]just[/b] as the second ferry sails off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! We're too late!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoops... Probably shouldn't have made that stop for snacks on the way back...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe this! I'm going to miss the Best Party of `All Time,` and it's `your` fault!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe this! I'm going to miss the Best Party of [color=#e23b3b][i]All Time,[/i][/color] and it's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My fault?! I'm not the one who volunteered to go fetch Hector's `live` pig!
nodes.text_bbcode: My fault?! I'm not the one who volunteered to go fetch Hector's [color=#e23b3b][i]live[/i][/color] pig!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was trying to be nice... You know, for someone else. But I understand if that's a concept you're unfamiliar with.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is `exactly` what I've been trying to tell you, Tweed. You try too hard to be cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what I've been trying to tell you, Tweed. You try too hard to be cool.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You put all this effort into pleasing everyone, and you end up missing the boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Literally.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? This doesn't have anything to do with books!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I meant... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I don't want to have to deal with Princess being all upset with me for ruining your big night, so...
Colt wanders over toward the pier... Ben follows...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hate to break it to you, but the ferries are all gone...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but `the boats` aren't!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but [color=#e23b3b][i]the boats[/i][/color] aren't!

nodes.text: Colt gestures to the boats that are floating idly on the water, tethered to the dock.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... You're going to take one of these boats?! A boat that isn't yours?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's stealing!
Colt hops into one of the boats and starts untethering it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's long-term borrowing... Once the party's over, we'll bring it back. Like the owner's going to miss it while he's sleeping...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, if you feel guilty, you can even leave behind a few dollars for boat fuel.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're crazy if you think I'm stealing a boat!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, you want to be cool, Tweed? This is how. You don't need to have some Cool Guy strategy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our `own` boat is crazy cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] boat is crazy cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...
Just then, Hector comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: New game! Circle up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Circle up?! I love that game!
A few seconds later, a big group is gathered around Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who's ready to play... Spin the Coconut?!
Everyone cheers as Hector spins a coconut around!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: { Who's going to be kissing behind a pa-a-a-alm tree... {
The coconut finally stops spinning `and...` No one can tell where it's pointing!
nodes.text_bbcode: The coconut finally stops spinning [b]and...[/b] No one can tell where it's pointing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that was dumb. I'll go find a bottle!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not every game's a winner, people!
$ZOE nudges Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Having fun now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll admit it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I forgot how fun Hector's games can be... Even the ones that don't quite work out...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure the coconut was pointing at me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought so too, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't want to make out with a coconut!
As $ZOE and Amanda talk, Sam hears a giggle off in the distance...
There, behind a cluster of trees, she sees Nick and Sara laughing together!
Then Nick leans down and kisses Sara!
Unable to bear it, Sam gets up and leaves... But $ZOE doesn't notice!
Ben and Colt come to a slow pace as they near the island's dock...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! `Perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A voice blares on a megaphone behind them!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: This is the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Water cops!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: You are operating a stolen boat. Power down your motor and prepare to be boarded!
Colt turns the motor off...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to be okay, right? I mean, you can Colt your way out of this, right? Smooth talk the Coast Guard... Right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Fraid not, Tweed...
Colt buries his head in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm dead, man. I've got a record. I might have to go to juvie for this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I mean, like, prison for kids...
Sam arrives at the docks once again, her phone out, the message to The Dirty Dish typed and ready to be sent...
She's about to press SEND, when she notices Ben and Colt talking to the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You boys are in a lot of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This guy, really? He's everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't understand, sir...
But just as fast, another feeling takes its place. A nagging feeling in the back of her head that says...
`Something's wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Something's wrong.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Do you want to come in and eat dinner with my family?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Fencing is a game of points.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: A fencer can score a point in one of two ways, either by landing a hit to his opponent's torso or by driving his opponent off the edge of the `piste.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A fencer can score a point in one of two ways, either by landing a hit to his opponent's torso or by driving his opponent off the edge of the [color=#e23b3b][i]piste.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We'll play to three points. Is that acceptable?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... I mean, you know best.
Bertram raises his left arm for balance and extends his sword hand. He taps the tip of his blade against yours.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Then we begin... `En garde!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then we begin... [color=#e23b3b][i]En garde![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `En garde!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]En garde![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Bertram hops deftly back. He waggles his foil in a circle and `thrusts!` Howard quickly...
nodes.text_bbcode: Bertram hops deftly back. He waggles his foil in a circle and [b]thrusts![/b] Howard quickly...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, uh, Mr. Bloomsburg, what's next? Horseback riding? Driving around in a golden car? Caviar-eating contest?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Your imagination is certainly active.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I actually believe that we'll spend the last of our time together on a walk.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: There are some things I'd like to clear up with you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course.
Suddenly Howard's phone beeps.
It's a text from $ZOE that reads, 'Meet me at the football field. Bring your interviewer too!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, if you want to visit my school, it's just up the road.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can show you the football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: That would be a delight.
Bertram and Howard walk around the large football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: So, we're getting to the end of our time together, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. And then you make your decision about whether or not I get in.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes. But first, I have a few final questions to ask you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Why did you choose Kingston University?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I want to go to Kingston for many reasons. But above all, I want to go for Kingston's...

options.label: Episode One: The New Head Cheerleader

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, everyone...
After school, the cheerleaders hide near Matteo's scooter...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's coming!
When Matteo nears, they jump out of their hiding spot!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yah! Pretty scooter thieves! Wait... What is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's your personal cheer! One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Did you have a tough day? Don't worry, that's okay! {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { You should never feel gray-o, when your name is Matteo! {
$ZOE stops when she realizes that none of the other cheerleaders are following her lead...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Girls?
$ZOE looks back at the cheerleaders. They're gathered around Jill. She's on the ground, holding her stomach and groaning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Unnh! So much food!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Actually, my stomach's been upset all day too...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Blech. I ate two pizzas `today...` $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.
nodes.text_bbcode: Blech. I ate two pizzas [color=#e23b3b][i]today...[/i][/color] $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh! I think my new No Diet diet might be at fault here... The cheerleaders aren't able to regulate themselves!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: May I please drive my vehicle away?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I like that you girls aren't wearing those uniforms anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... `Alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... [color=#e23b3b][i]Alone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ew! Gross!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I knew it was a bad idea to wear whatever we wanted! Great idea, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...
The next day, in a dark, goblin dungeon...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spinning lion frenzy!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your `roaring` attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your [color=#e23b3b][i]roaring[/i][/color] attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!

nodes.text: Next to the nerd table, the cheerleaders stare at $ZOE, waiting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, on three, I guess. One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Don't worry! Never fear! Slay those goblins! Hear our cheer! {

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { You're in a corner, nerves a'plenty! {

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: { That's okay! Roll a twenty! {
Dex tosses his character sheet into the air!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I can't concentrate with all this incessant cheering!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It is `really` distracting...
nodes.text_bbcode: It is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] distracting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't like us here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! You're ruining Ogres 'N' Elves!
In Auto Shop, Megan is welding two motorcycle parts together. Behind her, the cheerleaders gather...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like we practiced... One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: { `Weeeeeeeeeld!` {
nodes.text_bbcode: { [color=#3b78e2][i]Weeeeeeeeeld![/i][/color] {

nodes.text: Megan snarls, lifting her welding hood up!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: First, you're not helping!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And second, you couldn't come up with anything more creative?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We tried... But we don't know anything about cars!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Get out!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or stay... I'm cool with you staying!
On stage, the principal of Wilson High announces the next speaker... Outgoing Student Body President Alexei!
Alexei takes the stage...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, guys. It's been a pretty crazy four years, am I right? We all had a lot of memories... Good times... Bad times... Crazy times...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That time Steve got his head stuck in a bucket and ran around screaming for two hours...
The whole room breaks into laughter...
Justin pedals with all his energy, his feet like pistons of continuous energy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Grr!
Soon there's separation between his bike and Darren's car!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey!
Erik appears on Justin's right side, pedaling just as hard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Justin! I'm not cut out for this kind of sweaty adventure! I think we're going to have to...
But Stiletto's car knifes between them, separating Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt the party!
Stiletto banks her car left toward Justin! He veers left...
And almost crashes into Elliana's car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Don't you dare scratch me, American nerd!
Both cars are parallel to Justin, closing the space between each other, sandwiching him!
Stiletto smiles as she pulls out a paintball gun and points it at Justin!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Night, night.
Elliana whips out a gun of her own, aiming it out her passenger side window!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Sweet dreams!
Score Up!
Justin slams on the brakes just as both girls fire their guns!
Their paintballs splatter all over each other's clothes, cars, and faces!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: My car! My perfect car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: My face! My perfect face!
Meanwhile, Justin turns down a side street, and Erik rides up behind him...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nice steering, buddy!
But Darren and Skazz's cars hug the turn and accelerate right behind Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: What are you riding away for?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not going to make it! I'm not going to make it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: We just want to be friends!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hiccup! Hiccup! Hiccup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Keep pedaling, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cars always beat bikes, Justin! I'm statistically done for!
Steve leans out the window of Skazz's car and fires a round of paintballs at Erik's back!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh. New favorite sport! Nerd hunting!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Leave him alone, you butt ugly jerk!
Steve fires another pellet, this one causing Erik's tire to explode!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whooooooa! Wobbly time!
Darren's car comes forward, this time rubbing the exposed frame of Erik's back wheel! Sparks fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Ha! Check it out! Fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You son of a...
Justin slows down so that he's right in front of Erik's bike!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't think so!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You have to jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I could also `not` jump!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure I could also [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] jump!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll catch you!
Another blast of sparks shoots off of Erik's back wheel!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On second thought...
Erik leaps from his bike!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woooop!
Sara walks through the hotel parking lot. As she's nearing the lobby, Officer Monte angrily strides up to her!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just what do you think you're doing, Bonnie?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's Sara, actually.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know that! Of all the young delinquents I saw on that bus, I didn't think it would be you breaking curfew rules.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah said I should cry... But I can't cry on command!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I forgot how fun Hector's games can be... Even the ones that don't quite work out...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure the coconut was pointing at me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought so too, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't want to make out with a coconut!
As $ZOE and Amanda talk, Sam hears a giggle off in the distance...
There, behind a cluster of trees, she sees Nick and Sara laughing together!
Then Nick leans down and kisses Sara!
Unable to bear it, Sam gets up and leaves... But $ZOE doesn't notice!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Talking to Erik really cheered me up... I laughed a lot.
Just then, Hector comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: New game! Circle up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Circle up?! I love that game!
A few seconds later, a big group is gathered around Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who's ready to play... Spin the Coconut?!
Everyone cheers as Hector spins a coconut around!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: { Who's going to be kissing behind a pa-a-a-alm tree... {
The coconut finally stops spinning `and...` No one can tell where it's pointing!
nodes.text_bbcode: The coconut finally stops spinning [b]and...[/b] No one can tell where it's pointing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that was dumb. I'll go find a bottle!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not every game's a winner, people!
$ZOE nudges Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Having fun now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll admit it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you've met Erik before...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's nice `and` to prove that he's not like a certain `other` guy...
nodes.text_bbcode: He's nice [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] to prove that he's not like a certain [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] guy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, how do you feel about athletes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Athletes are the paramount of physical achievement!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I would give my arm to be an athlete!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Although, that might limit the sports I could play...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Enjoy!
$ZOE winks at Sam and goes over to talk to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did I just pass a test?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, just so you understand, I had $ZOE bring you over here so I could get my mind off Nick and Sara...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm not interested or anything... Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! You can call me Mr. Platonic!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm probably not going to do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And hey, if it's a distraction you need, let me tell you all about my character in Ogres 'N' Elves!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He's a one-armed giant named Big Gruff!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it with you and arms?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, `The Innie!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... Anyway, he's saving up money to buy his own inn, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And how much fake money do you have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To be honest... None. I spent it all on a magical donkey, but I haven't seen any of the fruits of my labor...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just a lot of magical donkey dung...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hee hee... You're kind of funny, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Weird, but funny.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For distracting me... Even for just a little while...
On the island, $ZOE approaches Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, this is...
As soon as $ZOE validates Amanda's idea, the cheerleaders begin to chatter with excitement... Ideas pour out of them!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The next time it rains, let's make a big pool of mud, and just dance in it! It'll be so raw!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That sounds... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I think if I got shot out of a cannon I could do, like, thirty or forty flips in the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That... Uh... That might be dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: More importantly, why are we only cheering for `sports?!` Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: More importantly, why are we only cheering for [color=#e23b3b][i]sports?![/i][/color] Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you say, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's...
Just then, $ZOE feels a tapping on her shoulder... She turns to face...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: In my office, right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
A few moments later, in the principal's office...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it, Principal Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm very concerned.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Cheerleading is a long-standing institution, $ZOE. I've seen more shifts in power than you can count.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Every once in a while, a sweet, nice girl like you takes over... And every time it's the same thing...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The sweet, nice girl tries to turn cheerleading into a democracy, and the other cheerleaders walk all over her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the girls haven't been walking all over me!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: They haven't?! This morning, I got called into Mr. Russell's class... The girls were doing backflips for Phil just because he lit his own Bunsen burner!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And this kind of disruption is just the tip of the iceberg... The nurse's office has been a revolving door of cheerleaders with upset stomachs!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
