nodes.text: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, I `will cancel cheerleading!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, I [color=#3b78e2][i]will cancel cheerleading![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I can't? Dear, I'm the principal. I can do what I want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's so unfair! Cheerleading is important! It boosts team spirit!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Then you're going to have to do something about it, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now tell me what you're going to do to get those girls under your control.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Behind me is the new school, redone in the image of the old one, but with a few minor tweaks...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: We are no longer the Centerscore Lizards... We are, from now on, the Twin Branches Squirrels!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Squirrels?! That's going to take some getting used to...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Crazy! I don't know about you guys, but I'm Lizard through and through.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Does that mean I have to wear a squirrel suit? Because that sounds `really` furry and `really` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Does that mean I have to wear a squirrel suit? Because that sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] furry and [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Settle down... I know the new name will take some getting used to...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: To commemorate this moment, I've asked the cheerleaders to perform! They'll be doing so under the guidance of their new Head Cheerleader, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can do it, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go Squirrels!
Some of the students look at Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just thought I'd give the new name a spin...
$ZOE and the cheerleaders take the stage... They line up in a tight, crisp formation.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ready, okay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Things were good, things were great! {

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { Then we got hit by a big earthquake! {

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: { Times were tough, times were rotten! {

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { But we are Lizards, er... Squirrels... Or have you forgotten?! {

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: { We've rebuilt the school, a place for learning... {

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: { Fun, and young romances... {

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { Yay! Yay! Yay! Twin Branches! {
The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Time for the stunt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! What stunt?
The cheerleaders cradle Amanda in their arms...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Three...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Two...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: One...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleaders stop an instant before throwing Amanda into the air.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you guys doing?! This is really dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: It's just a stunt...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A stunt you didn't run by me first...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Because you probably would have said 'no.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, because it involves tossing and catching Amanda on a tiny, rickety stage!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! That could have hurt!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry...
The crowd starts to boo. $ZOE eyes the podium and strides over to it. She taps on the microphone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Hello, Twin Branches.
The crowd quiets...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you're upset because you didn't get to see a stunt, but what you just saw was actually a scary moment. Thankfully, Amanda's okay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: These cheerleaders are my responsibility... And if I can't keep them in control, then I'm not doing a very good job.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The truth is... I'm not meant to be a Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't have the kind of personality that's assertive non-stop... It's too much work. And half the time, I just end up feeling mean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not the kind of person I want to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'd like to announce that I'm stepping down as Head Cheerleader...
A murmur of shock ripples through the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If you're not Head Cheerleader, who is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Amanda... I just know `definitively` that it isn't me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, Amanda... I just know [color=#3b78e2][i]definitively[/i][/color] that it isn't me.

nodes.text: Wow! $ZOE stepped down from the Head Cheerleader position! Who will fill the void she's left behind?
Find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!
In the meantime, you played a great game! You were able to help $ZOE step up to the challenge of being Head Cheerleader!
And even though it wasn't the position for her, she learned a valuable lesson about herself. Congratulations!
As Principal Shapiro speaks, the cheerleaders gather near the stage...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Where's $ZOE? We're about to go on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I haven't seen her...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There she is!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why does she look so scary?!
$ZOE leaps onto the stage, storms across, and slams a stereo onto a nearby bench!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is boring, Principal Whatever Your Name Is!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Excuse me?
$ZOE wrests the microphone away from Shapiro.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone, listen up! From now on, we're going to do things `my` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone, listen up! From now on, we're going to do things [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] way!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Duh! Yes, it's me! Is something surprising, Maria?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just seem so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Was I talking to you, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Angry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nerds! Light some fireworks!
Pyrotechnics light the stage! $ZOE plays some music on the stereo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Audience! Start dancing!
No one moves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dance, or I'll make you dance!
The audience hesitantly begins to dance...
$ZOE dances on a nearby table!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo! Party! All right!
She sees the cheerleaders standing still onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing? Get into the pyramid now! Hector on the bottom!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What happened to the line?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those days are over with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Totes` over with!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over with!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders begrudgingly get into pyramid formation...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is Jessica back but in $ZOE's body?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think so, Amanda...
Months later...
$ZOE hands out flyers to students as they walk down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be `totes` epic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] epic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Attendance `is` mandatory, so if you don't come...
nodes.text_bbcode: Attendance [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] mandatory, so if you don't come...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be `super` disappointed!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How did you get Howard to be President of the high school when he's in college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't ask stupid questions, Maria! There's still some room at the bottom of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE, why are you doing this? You're not like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am `now,` Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tomorrow, Howie and I are going to be yachting in the bay with a Senator...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got to look my best... And that means cutting a few programs from the school budget!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I really like the new $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you do! What's not to like?! I'm `so` the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you do! What's not to like?! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] the best!

nodes.text: Oh no! This can't be the Good Ending! Not with $ZOE acting exactly like Jessica!
You `have` to play again and make this right!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [b]have[/b] to play again and make this right!

nodes.text: See if you can get $ZOE to the big rally!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now!
Howard, Hector and Ben release their lizards at the same time!
As the graduation caps come crashing down, everyone starts screaming!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Something's on my feet!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: The room's full of lizards!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Rabid reptiles! Rabid reptiles!
The room erupts in confusion and chaos! Everyone yells, runs, and scrambles!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mission accomplished! Go go `go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Mission accomplished! Go go [color=#e23b3b][i]go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard bolts away! He bursts out the front door into the parking lot.
Ben and Hector rush out of the side doors!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go! Run for my van!
Howard looks across the parking lot... And sees the van at the far end!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why did we park so far away?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It made sense at the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did it, Hector? `Did it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did it, Hector? [color=#e23b3b][i]Did it?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Behind them, the doors of the auditorium fly open, and Wilson students rush out! Alexei wriggles, kicking a lizard out of his pant leg, and screams...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: After them!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard has failed.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What... Is... `This?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What... Is... [color=#e23b3b][i]This?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A... Comical misunderstanding?
Two hours later, at the police station...
Howard's family arrives to pick him up!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Tell me, Officer... How bad is it?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, it's plenty bad, ma'am. He's facing two charges of trespassing and seven charges of unlawful mischief with newborn reptiles.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If I had my way, he'd be spending the rest of his life in the big house!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Just so I'm clear, when you say the 'big house,' are you referring to a mansion? An estate of sorts?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm referring to prison.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Okay. Cool. Got it. Just making sure.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I don't get to choose the sentence... So I'm thinking the worst he'll get is a fee of $50,000.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know! Talk about an outrage! Might as well let all the criminals go scot-free!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Speaking of which...
Howard shuffles out of his jail cell.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Hi, guys.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard. I'm `so` disappointed in you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Howard. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] disappointed in you!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Seriously! For a moment, I thought you might get to live in a mansion, and I was excited, but now I'm back to being disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'd expect this from the twins... But not you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so sorry... I... I don't know what I was thinking...
Kay and Kel rush out from behind their mother's back...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `We` don't know what you were thinking!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We[/i][/color] don't know what you were thinking!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How could you get caught on such a basic prank! I mean, talk about an amateur!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're ashamed to call you our big brother!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, I... I know it was a bad idea, but... I just wanted to have one last memory at Twin Branches before I left for Centerscore U...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, unfortunately, I think that's off the table now. After we pay off your fine, we won't be able to afford your tuition.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sorry, kid. You messed up.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Big time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Big time![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Wow! Talk about a terrible ending! We know you can do better than that!
There's a scream from the far side of the room as Hector and Ben release their lizards!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! We did it! Run!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! I... I didn't have time to...
It's too late! All of the people attending graduation scream and lunge away, as lizards scurry underfoot. Hector and Ben run away...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Wait!
Howard fumbles with his bag of lizards...
And knocks over the stand he's hiding behind! Everyone in the room turns to stare at him...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I get it! I finally get it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get what, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why I keep feeling the way I do! I've spent all day doing awesome stuff, but it still didn't feel like the right way to say goodbye...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's not high school I'm afraid of saying goodbye to. It's you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm okay having one last prank or one last game or one last drink of water at the good fountain... But I can't even begin to think about having one last date with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Howard... You don't have to. We're `not` breaking up.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Howard... You don't have to. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] breaking up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but... I think I'm terrified of losing you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What if it doesn't work out? What if Centerscore U is too far? What if you meet someone else?
Howard turns away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me `so much.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me [color=#e23b3b][i]so much.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...
$ZOE leans forward and hugs Howard from behind, pressing her face against his back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You won't lose me. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're `perfect` for each other. We're meant to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] for each other. We're meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll never have to say goodbye. Just 'see you soon.'
Howard turns back to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I promise.
Howard leans down and gives $ZOE a long, tender kiss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too.
Wow! Looks like Howard finally figured out what his dream was trying to tell him... And he got the closure he needed! Great job!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Gasp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gasp![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get it now! I finally get it! The answer I was looking for all day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't see you today, $ZOE, because I'm not ready to say goodbye to you... And I'm `not` ready to say goodbye to high school!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't see you today, $ZOE, because I'm not ready to say goodbye to you... And I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] ready to say goodbye to high school!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I need to stay back another year!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's perfect! I could prank Wilson again... Play more high school football... Take more classes, and you `know` they'd be easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's perfect! I could prank Wilson again... Play more high school football... Take more classes, and you [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] they'd be easy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you and I wouldn't have to break up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, please, you're confusing me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even if I humored this ridiculous idea, you `can't` stay back another year! You graduate tomorrow!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if I humored this ridiculous idea, you [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] stay back another year! You graduate tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or do I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! You do!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or... `Do I?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... [color=#e23b3b][i]Do I?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Later that night, a half-dozen fire trucks are stationed around the newly rebuilt Twin Branches campus, putting out a small fire. Howard stands to the side...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Howard! What on earth were you thinking, breaking into the school so you could play with fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guess I'm just careless and irresponsible like that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: In light of this disciplinary breach, there's no way I can allow you to graduate...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And since the fire `somehow` only destroyed my academic transcript for the last year...
nodes.text_bbcode: And since the fire [color=#e23b3b][i]somehow[/i][/color] only destroyed my academic transcript for the last year...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm afraid you'll have to retake your senior year!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no! Whatever will I do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guess I'll just have to keep coming to this school and having more great memories! What a tragedy!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: ...Why are you talking like that? And why do you keep smiling?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just so wacky and crazy?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, whatever the reason, you won't be coming back to `this` school under any circumstance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, whatever the reason, you won't be coming back to [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] school under any circumstance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Burning school property is a tremendous offense, Howard! You're officially expelled from Twin Branches High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But you said I need to retake senior year...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Yes! You do! And you will...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: At whatever other school will take you!
And so... That September... Howard strolls onto his first day of school...
At Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just lay low... Don't make eye-contact... No one will recognize me...
Howard walks with his head low. All around, people glare at him...
And then a hand grabs his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey! You're that punk that pranked graduation last year!
A crowd of Wilson guys circles around Howard, rolling up their sleeves and cracking their knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it too late to play the comical misunderstanding card?

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Oh yeah.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aiiiiieeeeee!
Howard wasn't ready to move on from high school... But this can't be what he had in mind!
Try again, and see if you get him a happier ending!
Justin and Erik pedal furiously out of the lot!
Several Wilson cars peel out behind them, slamming onto the street right behind Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cripes!
Justin pedals furiously, stealing glances back over his shoulder...
From the pack of cars, Darren's surges out, the engine roaring!
Skazz walks right into the cabin, pushing past Paige and Prissy...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Watch it!
And stops right in front of Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Why haven't you introduced these girls?! They look so... So... Familiar and...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hot!
Sara has failed.

nodes.text: The girls step into their hotel room...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! It smells like a hotel!
Sara sets her stuff down on one of the beds and looks around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dibs on the bed near the window.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You can't call 'dibs'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just did, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey guys, there's no point in fighting because none of you should plan on sleeping.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh really? What do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We are going to sneak out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not this again...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? The swim finals are tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Come on, Jane. This is probably the first time you've been out from under your mother's thumb...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So live a little!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're just going to go have fun for a little bit... And we'll come back, get some sleep, and kick butt tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Besides, you're the one who said hot tubbing would be awesome. We're not going to get the chance staying in.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah, last time we snuck out, it was a disaster...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Which means you have to come out. It's your second chance! Amanda, what about you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll go if more people go...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Linda` would have gone with me. She's not lame like everyone else...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Linda[/i][/color] would have gone with me. She's not lame like everyone else...

nodes.text: Hannah turns to Sara and shoots her a pleading look.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're my last hope. Come on, Sara...
Sara has failed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't the way my cousin behaves... You've got to calm down!
Sam looks at the message... The SEND key glows temptingly in front of her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're crazy if you think I'm stealing a boat!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, you want to be cool, Tweed? This is how. You don't need to have some Cool Guy strategy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our `own` boat is crazy cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: You just need a boat, so you take one. And guess what? Showing up in our [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] boat is crazy cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was `my idea!` Colt didn't have anything to do with it!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#e23b3b][i]my idea![/i][/color] Colt didn't have anything to do with it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Tweed, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Colt? You mean the kid we've already got a full rap sheet on? If he didn't have anything to do with this, I'm a concert pianist.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, then I'd like to hear you play because I'm telling the truth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it's an unlikely scenario, but I bet you didn't expect us to have a pig with us when you stopped us, did you?

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well... No...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unlikely scenarios `can` happen, and this is one of them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlikely scenarios [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] happen, and this is one of them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tweed! You don't know what you're doing...
Ben ignores Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig `and` operate this boat.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] operate this boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt was walking by, so I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not how it happened.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt was riding by on his motorcycle, looking super cool, then I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I do remember something in his past about a motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, I told him I'd compensate him for taking the trip with me, but he didn't know I was stealing the boat... I told him it was mine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm telling you, that's not what happened!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me the real story, Colt?
Colt starts to talk, but then he looks at Ben...
And something in him gives...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Tweed's right. That's... That's how it happened...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This story stinks like a... Like a pig in a boat!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A second ago you were disagreeing with him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get `him` free...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] free...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You gotta believe me. Don't send an innocent kid to juvenile hall.
Monte stares hard at Ben and Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine. You seem like a good kid, so I'll believe you. Even though I don't know what kind of a name 'Tweed' is...
The officer looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You can go... But... I'll be keeping an eye out for you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
The officer handcuffs Ben and escorts him onto the Coast Guard ship. The boat heads back to the mainland...
Nearby, Sam looks at the message she's typed out on her phone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe Ben did that for Colt... It was so stupid and... And unselfish.
Suddenly the message Sam's written seems petty and utterly wrong.
Without another moment's hesitation, she deletes the message.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll never even `think` about doing something like that again!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll never even [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about doing something like that again!

nodes.text: After word of what happened travels around the island, Denni comes up to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben really got taken away?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, and it wasn't even his fault... I mean... I didn't think we were gonna get caught!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not pissed off at me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You were just being you... And I know you took the boat because you thought coming to the party was important to me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Granted, it wasn't your `finest` hour...
nodes.text_bbcode: Granted, it wasn't your [color=#3b78e2][i]finest[/i][/color] hour...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll try not to kick you while you're down...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's going to happen to Ben?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't think it'll be too bad for him... Just a fine and some community service.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, that's not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Kind of a `friendly` thing for him to do, wasn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of a [color=#3b78e2][i]friendly[/i][/color] thing for him to do, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I hear you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course, Princess! Let's go make out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sigh. Sure.
Looks like Ben's actions inspired Sam to do the right thing and eased friction between him and Colt.
You played a great game! You helped Sam stay calm in a tough situation, you helped Ben make a tremendous sacrifice...
And weird as it is, you also managed to help Ben escort a huge pig to an island party! Great job!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It wasn't my idea! It was Colt's!
Ben points his finger at Colt's face!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And what? You were just along for the ride?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I knew it was wrong, but I'm not a troublemaker...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If it weren't for Colt, I never would have gotten on the boat in the first place...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Colt? You've got quite a reputation. I bet what this guy's saying is true, isn't it?
Colt looks at Ben, who stares at him pleadingly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Tweed didn't do anything wrong.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Very well, then... You're free to go, son.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on, piggy!
Ben takes the pig and runs off, leaving Colt behind.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're the one we want anyway, Colt. Quite a rap sheet. You'll be going to juvie for a `long` time...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're the one we want anyway, Colt. Quite a rap sheet. You'll be going to juvie for a [color=#e23b3b][i]long[/i][/color] time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shove it, will you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ben just completely abandoned Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just confirms what I already knew... People are the worst!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's it!
Sam presses the SEND key, submitting her post to the Dirty Dish...
A few minutes later, word has spread all over the island...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe someone would do this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe it's not so bad... I mean, your dad's a little out of touch... Maybe he won't find out about it...
A second later, Sara's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no... It's him...
Nearby, Sam watches on gleefully... She turns... And runs right into $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it was you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? Consider us through!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Through? We're family! It's not like you can break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I just did! Don't ever talk to me again! Goodbye!
$ZOE marches away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE...
Sam looks back at the sad faces of Sara and Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I went a little too far... But it's too late now...
Too late indeed! With Colt going to juvie, Nick and Sara on the verge of breaking up, and $ZOE disowning Sam, you might have guessed it...
This isn't the Good Ending! Play again and see if you can help Ben and Sam with both of their situations!
Ben and Colt come to a slow pace as they near the island's dock...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! `Perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What'd I tell you, Tweed? Nothing to it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A voice blares on a megaphone behind them!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: This is the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Water cops!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: You are operating a stolen boat. Power down your motor and prepare to be boarded!
Colt turns the motor off...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to be okay, right? I mean, you can Colt your way out of this, right? Smooth talk the Coast Guard... Right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Fraid not, Tweed...
Colt buries his head in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm dead, man. I've got a record. I might have to go to juvie for this...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I mean, like, prison for kids...
Sam arrives at the docks once again, her phone out, the message to The Dirty Dish typed and ready to be sent...
She's about to press SEND, when she notices Ben and Colt talking to the Coast Guard!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You boys are in a lot of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This guy, really? He's everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't understand, sir...
The next day, $ZOE is driving Howard to the park...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is this event we're going to again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a little gathering I put together for you and some of your friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you could use some cheering up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really want to be cheered up right now, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you don't. No one ever `wants` to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you don't. No one ever [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that logic...
Howard presses his head against the car window... A slow pop song comes on the radio...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But nice try, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had to give it a shot... You know, you're less of a pushover than you used to be!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Publicly exposing Jessica's evil will do that to a girl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have avoided confessing my awful feelings to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they're still my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!

nodes.text: Sam sits down on the bed next to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Howard's really sad about all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... He's pretty down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That surprises me... I always thought of him as a Centerscore U. kind of guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did too. I think maybe everyone did...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you've already got some super sweet plan to cheer him up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know me so well! I planned a picnic with some friends...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope it works...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.title: The New Head Cheerleader
nodes.subtitle: Does she have what it takes to lead?

nodes.text: After school one day, $ZOE and Howard walk together toward the gym...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eeeep! Howard, I'm so excited for cheer practice! It's the only thing I've been thinking about all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No kidding...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why do you say that?
Earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Finally! Finally! Finally!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica's gone, and I'm Head Cheerleader! That means no more girl politics! No more drama! Gasp! No more `laundry` duty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica's gone, and I'm Head Cheerleader! That means no more girl politics! No more drama! Gasp! No more [color=#3b78e2][i]laundry[/i][/color] duty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for blabbering like a lunatic! You were saying something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... This is the `guy's` locker room.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... This is the [color=#e23b3b][i]guy's[/i][/color] locker room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, whoops!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee! You don't have a shirt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe I'm transparent! But do you understand how great practice is going to be? It'll be like being hugged by the sun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's... That's pretty great... `Hot,` but great.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... That's pretty great... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hot,[/i][/color] but great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Why aren't you smiling? Aren't you excited for me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am, $ZOE, trust me... This day has been a long time coming... And you deserve to revel in Jessica's absence more than anyone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I just think about how Paula, Taylor, and Jessica did really mean things when they were the Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm worried there's a reason they were like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, you're worried that...

options.label: I won't be a good Head Cheerleader?

nodes.text: The next day, at cheer practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I don't get more aggressive, Shapiro will cancel cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, everyone. Today, we're going to...
Jill interrupts her.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I want to work on some new stunts! I talked the Auto Shop guys into rigging this hoop for me.
Jill sets the hoop in a special, suspended clamp high in the air and presses a button on a remote control... The hoop lights on fire!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Pretty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Now I just need one of you to toss me through it!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hector and I will do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'll catch you on the other side!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awesome! I `love` fire!
nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] fire!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys! We can't do this stunt!
The cheerleaders turn to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.title: Date Auction
nodes.subtitle: Can Ben find a new girlfriend?

nodes.text: It's a beautiful afternoon in the city of Centerscore...
The day is warm, the sun is out, the birds are singing...
And Ben is wrapped in a blanket, sadly contemplating the contents of his fridge.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm still upset about Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...When I shouldn't even be giving her a second thought!
As Ben prepares himself a sandwich...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we'd been together for such a long time...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's almost as bad as when Denni broke up with me...
Ben takes his sandwich and walks into the lightless den, where a video game console is hooked up to the large TV.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least this time, I have an awesome video game to get my mind off her...
He sets his sandwich down and starts playing.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Finally! The boss fight against Sandman The Social Elitist!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's taken forever to get here!
Some furious button smashing later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just a few more hits... And you're gone!
And that's when Spencer bursts into the room, unhooks the game console, and throws a controller in Ben's face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing?! I was just about to finish him off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm saving you from yourself, man. What have you been doing all weekend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Playing this video game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' `by yourself` in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' [color=#e23b3b][i]by yourself[/i][/color] in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're wearing a blanket, you haven't showered, and you're surrounded by moldy food!
Ben looks over. His sandwich is covered in mold, completely rotten.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...What do you want, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I came to get you out of here. You need to leave your house.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Or at least leave your bedroom! Do you remember when you started playing this game?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like, Friday night? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what time is it now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Saturday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Try three in the afternoon on Sunday!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's time to admit you've got a problem...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, you're not. If you were 'fine', you'd actually put shoes on in the morning...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you were `'fine',` you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...
nodes.text_bbcode: If you were [color=#e23b3b][i]'fine',[/i][/color] you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `If you were fine`...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If you were fine[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I get it! I'm not 'fine' at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm not going to get over Jessica in a day. What am I supposed to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You need to go out...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: With a girl.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, you have one last date tonight...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And hopefully it'll be better than the last two.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if I'm feeling up to it... Do you think Sam would mind if I canceled?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You can't cancel on Samface! She's looking forward to this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: She's in the same boat as you are.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, we both broke up our relationships because the other person was a control freak bent on making us their puppet President?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know what I mean. Difficult break-ups.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... If you think she really wants this, I'll spend time with her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you, but... Make sure you take care of her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I had to rough up that Nick kid. I'd hate to do the same to you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll be nice, I swear.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So what are you two doing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I went out the last two nights, so since it's Sunday and I want something low key...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I figured we'd just stay in, eat dinner, and watch a movie...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's good! Samface is pretty low maintenance. Don't try too hard to make it all fancy-schmancy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. Hey, want to help me set up?
Spencer slaps Ben on the back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha! No.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're on your own. But good luck.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just... Try to make her happy.
Spencer heads out. Ben turns around to prepare the room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I should get dinner started...
Ben peers into the fridge and sees hamburger patties and filet mignon steaks.
And inside his mind...

nodes.speaker: Photo 2
nodes.text: Uhhh... N... No...
And inside his mind...
And inside his mind...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is... Kind of weird...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I recall the world being more... `Worldy...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I recall the world being more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Worldy...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, he lands on solid ground! He looks around and finds himself on...
The football field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh. Okay. The football field. That's cool. I like...
A ball appears in Howard's hands!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Football!
Jacob comes running up the field...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey! New kid!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who? Me? No, I'm not the new...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah you, `meat!` You might think you're off the hook because you're friends with $USR... But I'm still watching you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah you, [color=#e23b3b][i]meat![/i][/color] You might think you're off the hook because you're friends with $USR... But I'm still watching you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR... Man, that guy really fell off the grid...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah... We all do, sooner or later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We do?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hey! What are you waiting for, meat? Get the ball down the field! It's the big game with Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right! Wilson! We hate those guys!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah! I heard they eat babies!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That seems a little much...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't mess this up, Howard! Everyone whose opinion you've ever cared about is in the stands, watching!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Is that Suzie Gimball from first grade?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: No time to gawk, meat! Go! Go like the meat you are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right!
Howard turns and sprints down the field! Vampire Wilson players rush from all sides!

nodes.speaker: Vampire Players
nodes.text: Blooooood...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! What? Why? Why would that be a thing?!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Toss the ball, Howard! Toss it to the `team captain!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Toss the ball, Howard! Toss it to the [color=#e23b3b][i]team captain![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right! The team captain during my freshman year! That would be...
That day, Howard eats lunch at the Center Table. He listens to some of the guys talking...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm telling you guys, next year is gonna be `amazing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm telling you guys, next year is gonna be [color=#e23b3b][i]amazing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heck yeah! It's my senior year! And I'm gonna have the most amazing year!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm talking constant parties... Constant road trips... Constant make-outs!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! I like two out of three!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah you do, baby!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, which two?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I spent this last year just messed up in so much drama... I'm just looking forward to relaxing, hanging out, and having a good time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Sounds like you guys are going to have a great time.
Hector leans over and pokes Howard's arm.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey. `Hey.` What's wrong, buddy? Having a case of the Graduation Grumps? Eh? Eh?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey. [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey.[/i][/color] What's wrong, buddy? Having a case of the Graduation Grumps? Eh? Eh?

nodes.text: Hector tickles Howard. Howard slaps him away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're a model of sensitivity, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw come on, man, I'm just joshing you. How are you not jazzed for college? It's like constant parties, road trips, and make-outs!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Isn't that how you just described your plans for next year?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm... You know... Awesome like that.
The cafeteria door swings open. Taylor strolls in, heading towards Brendan...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! I thought we were meeting at noon? What happened?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wilson High is having their graduation ceremony right now, and traffic is terrible!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who has graduation on a Wednesday afternoon?
And suddenly, Howard lights up with inspiration! He slams his hand down on the table!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ahhh! Loud noises!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys! `Guys!` I have a great idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys! [color=#e23b3b][i]Guys![/i][/color] I have a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We should go prank Wilson's graduation!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait... Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah! Why not? It'll be great!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, How-town, I love a good prank as much as anyone but... I don't know if I'm really feeling it now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean, a prank is a lot of effort...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, come on! We `have` to do it! For...
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, come on! We [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to do it! For...

nodes.text: Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!

nodes.title: Wilson Strikes Back
nodes.subtitle: Can Justin warn Twin Branches in time?

nodes.text: The 4th of July...
Justin walks into Principal Shapiro's office. Shapiro is standing at the window, looking out. She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Principal? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm in school on July 4th when I could be poolside at a BBQ with my...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: ...Uh, friend.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: So, no. It's not my best day.
Shapiro sits at her desk and motions for Justin to take the seat across from her.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's definitely weird to be here during the summer. At least the new school facilities have state-of-the-art air conditioning...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: True, but that doesn't answer my question... How are you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Me? Fine! Fine! Everything's fine!
Shapiro raises an eyebrow.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I've come to know you pretty well during your term as President, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I can tell when you're lying...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you caught me...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just... I'm disappointed that I'm not going to be President next year, that's all. It's sort of become my identity. My thing.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry that you didn't win, Justin. However, if your Presidency is any indication of who you are, then I'm confident you'll find a new `thing` next year...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry that you didn't win, Justin. However, if your Presidency is any indication of who you are, then I'm confident you'll find a new [color=#3b78e2][i]thing[/i][/color] next year...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks... But if it's all the same to you, I really don't want to talk about this. Can we just move on to the reason you called me in?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Sure...
Shapiro folds a letter and inserts it into an envelope...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You probably found out about the prank that got pulled at Wilson High during their graduation ceremony...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, despicable. Some of our idiots flooded their ceremony with baby lizards. I've never been more embarrassed to represent Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Oh, lighten up, Justin! I found it amusing. School rivalries can spice things up from time to time.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I did hear that Alexei had so many lizards crawling on him he was practically a terrarium...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Nevertheless, Principal Dunkirk is furious.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I would be too if some of his students had ruined our graduation with a bunch of wild badgers...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Anyway, he agreed to dissuade his students from retaliating, but knowing him, it won't happen without a formal apology and a gift bag...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A gift bag?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Don't ask. It's a Principal thing.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Riiiiight. So... Where do I come in?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: As my messenger. Take this letter and this gift bag and deliver them to Dunkirk. If you don't get over there quickly, I'm certain that Wilson `will` retaliate!
nodes.text_bbcode: As my messenger. Take this letter and this gift bag and deliver them to Dunkirk. If you don't get over there quickly, I'm certain that Wilson [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] retaliate!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I don't want this escalating. I don't want anyone getting hurt. Do you understand me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: On another note... After this, I probably won't be needing your services for the remainder of the school year...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait... So, this will be my final act as President? Delivering a letter of apology and a gift bag to Wilson High?!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Do you have a problem with your assignment?
Justin and Erik are running through the woods when they come upon a cabin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A cabin in the woods?! Perfect! We're safe now!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Easy there, Erik... Let's not do anything...
Erik bounds over to the front door of the cabin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...Hasty.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin! We need asylum, and we need it fast! Wilson could show up at any minute!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, maybe there are cute girls here!
Erik knocks on the cabin's front door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, are you insane?! Cute girls go to malls or the beach or college campuses...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Or they play role-playing games and date guys with reddish hair and a black earring!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's weirdly specific...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The point is... You're not going to find `any` in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... You're not going to find [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're more likely to find a creepy guy with a scythe collection...
The door opens, revealing Paige, Prissy, and the girls of Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, hey there, Prissy! Didn't expect to find you here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Although we were just talking about cute girls...
Behind Prissy, Madisenn trips, spilling her soda on the rug!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Great! Another mess to clean!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you ladies doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? This is my dad's cabin! It's a slumber party, and we have a strict, no-guys policy, so...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No worries... Not my first time getting kicked out of the rodeo...
Paige starts to close the door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let us in... Please!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you `not` just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We need you to let us in! We...

options.label: Are in a lot of danger!

nodes.title: Swim Team Trip
nodes.subtitle: Can Sara figure out her feelings for Nick?

nodes.text: It's early in the morning, and Sara is in the pool in the swim center.
The water is cold, but she slices through it, moving as fast as she can.
She touches the far end of the pool and surfaces.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...
On the side, Coach Kessler frowns at her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I was hoping that a morning practice without all the other swimmers on the team would help you focus more.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But you've gained at least half a second since last week.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It's like you're not even trying. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's nothing, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's nothing, `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's nothing, [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then why aren't you performing at your peak? The championship finals are tomorrow morning!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll be fine. I won the Wilson Freestyle, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The Swimming State Championship is much more important than the Wilson Freestyle.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Let's go one more time. Get your act together!
Sara steps onto the starting block. She looks down at the water, trying to visualize her swim.
But her thoughts soon wander...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I thought I'd be okay that Nick and I were just friends...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I seem to be more distracted by it than ever...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: On my mark... Get set...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't stop thinking about him... And what happened with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Go!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh!
Sara dives into the water!
The group returns to the hotel and congregates outside the hotel's aquatic center.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay... I scouted it out when we came in. The entrance to the pool is behind this gate.
Hannah tries the handle on the gate, but it doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's locked.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ugh, all this sneaking around, and we can't even get into the hot tub? What's the point?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Hey, no worries... We can scale this.
Lee indicates the stone wall.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Well, maybe a girl like you might have some trouble, but us guys can handle it...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Move over.
Jane takes a running start and gains enough momentum to hop over!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, that was easy. Hurry up and join me!
One by one, each of the swimmers vaults over the wall.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Huff!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Mmph!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
Finally, Sara is the last one on the other side.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Here goes nothing...
Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!

nodes.title: The Island Party
nodes.subtitle: Will Sam break up Nick and Sara?

nodes.text: Ben, Hector, $Scott, and Carson stand together on the pier that extends from Centerscore Beach...
On the sand nearby, a crowd of students waits in line, preparing to board a huge ferry boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gentlemen, we've pooled together our respective party prowesses to throw a truly magnificent gala!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Or...` Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of `All Time!` Boom! Coined it!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Or...[/i][/color] Smaller words. We're about to be hosts to the Best Party of [color=#e23b3b][i]All Time![/i][/color] Boom! Coined it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. These summer parties are so easy to plan with you guys. This one's going to be [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Carson shakes his head...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know how you guys convinced Prissy to let you throw a party on her dad's island, but this is awesome! I'm going to miss partying with my bros!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We will too, man! Hector, have we done everything we need to do?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's `perfect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All we have left is herding these peeps onto the ferry boats to the island, and then it's a lock for luau. Nothing can go wrong! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]perfect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHH!` Are you guys insane?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color] Are you guys insane?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Carson? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not at all! Don't you know the laws of jinxing?! Every time you call something perfect, you jinx it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Or have none of you thrown a party before?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've `all` thrown parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] thrown parties.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Then I don't need to remind you that something `always` goes wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I don't need to remind you that something [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] goes wrong!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We `are` perfect!
nodes.text_bbcode: But nothing will this time! So we're golden! We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] perfect!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `AHHHH!` Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHH![/i][/color] Stop that! I guarantee you... We're forgetting something.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right, man...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm glad someone has some sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we totally forgot...
Meanwhile, at the island party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not having any fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! But Sam, there are tiki torches and drinks in coconuts and...
A song with steel drums melodiously wafts through a nearby set of speakers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And island rhythms!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other `everywhere` I go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that's all great! But there's also Nick and Sara laughing and flirting with each other [color=#3b78e2][i]everywhere[/i][/color] I go!

nodes.text: A couple yards away, Nick playfully touches Sara's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hee! That sounds like a really funny picture!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The only thing that would make this worse would be some kind of lame ice-breaker game like...
Carson bounds into their midst...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Who's up for Truth or Volleyball? It's a new twist on an old favorite!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh...
A few minutes later, Sam, $ZOE, and the cheerleaders are standing on the opposite side of a net from Nick, Sara, and the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You sure you want to be on that side, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Positive. Let's get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: We'll start with Jill...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Uh... Nick... Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Truth!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay... Do you have feelings for someone on this court right now?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh! Juicy! I bet he's still got feelings for Sam!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I do have feelings for `someone...` Yeah.
nodes.text_bbcode: I do have feelings for [color=#e23b3b][i]someone...[/i][/color] Yeah.

nodes.text: Everyone gasps!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I love this game. Hannah, you're up!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam! Truth or Volleyball?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Volleyball.
Hannah takes the ball and hits it over the net... Jill digs it out, Maria sets it for Sam, and Sam coils her arm back to spike it at...
Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!
The morning after the island party, $ZOE and Sam are talking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you missed the rest of Hector's party games... They were so bad that they were actually entertaining!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's worse than Spin the Coconut?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bobbing for Pineapples.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Erik said it was like making out with an underwater porcupine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where'd you go anyway? I was talking to Amanda, then I turned around, and you were gone! I got worried...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I saw Nick kissing Sara... I couldn't bear it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, then I don't blame you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! You didn't decide to post the message about their relationship to The Dirty Dish, did you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's just say sometimes `not` doing something is the best decision you can make...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's just say sometimes [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] doing something is the best decision you can make...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay! I'm really proud of you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! I couldn't have done it without you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But enough about my stuff. What about you, cuz? How are you doing with this whole Howard going to Centerscore U. thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, um... Okay... I guess. I mean, he really wanted to go to Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, travel time to your boyfriend just dropped from twenty hours to twenty minutes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some part of you has got to feel happy about that!
Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!

nodes.title: A Kingston King
nodes.subtitle: Can Howard prove he's worthy of Kingston?

nodes.text: It's the morning of Howard's interview with Kingston University, and Zoe is talking with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how are you holding up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so glad that Kingston's decided to give me another chance to get in, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm nervous about this interview. There's just a huge knot where my stomach used to be.
$ZOE pats him on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's hard, but you can do this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were prepared for the last interview, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I was. But this is going to be nothing like the last interview.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What's different?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, last time, I was qualifying for a football scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My interviewer wasn't going to ask me any hard questions about what I want to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their `Kingston Kings` leadership program.
nodes.text_bbcode: There are no more football scholarships. The only way I'll be able to get in now is to qualify for their [color=#e23b3b][i]Kingston Kings[/i][/color] leadership program.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The Kingston Kings are the elite leaders of the school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They're involved in almost everything, and they usually go on to become prestigious politicians or super rich businessmen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I want to go to Kingston, I have to prove I'm going to be a Kingston King.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all just too much, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, that does sound intense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you're anxious, but you're going to do fine! You're a wonderful guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, but unfortunately 'good boyfriend' isn't one of the qualities they're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are they looking for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I was preparing for the interview, I found some materials that classify Kingston Kings as men of civic responsibility, culture, and honor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's good. You `are` all those things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's good. You [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] all those things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But can I prove that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you can't go into an interview thinking like that! Come on, say one nice thing about yourself before you start...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'm...
They walk a short distance from the restaurant to a large building.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: This way, this way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, where are we going?
Bertram flips a switch on the wall. There is a chunk-chunk sound as banks of lights turn on revealing an open area with a long mat.
Along the walls are racks filled with gleaming foils, epees, and rapiers.
And just ahead are practice dummies wearing padded white jackets and wire-mesh masks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Any prospective Kingston man must demonstrate proficiency at 'the sport of gentlemanly pokes'...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... That sounds kind of...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Fencing...` The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is `fencing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fencing...[/i][/color] The Sport of Gentlemanly Pokes is [color=#e23b3b][i]fencing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, `wow,` that is a relief...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]wow,[/i][/color] that is a relief...

nodes.text: Betram steps over to the practice dummies and retrieves two white fencing jackets. He offers one to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Here you are. Now put this on.
Howard struggles into the padded jacket, wrestling with the straps to secure it into place.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: What's the matter, Howard? You have put on fencing attire before, have you not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You stole my money!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All for a good cause...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope all your dates are boring and awkward.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, they're not for me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've already got a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Harper Anderson. Cute, red hair, psychic aunt?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You met her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, it's been a while.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But that means these three girls are all for you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's just what you need to get out of your slump. Come on. Just go on a date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've already set all the dates up for you...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It doesn't have to mean anything. Just go have fun. Leave your room, comb your hair... Lay off the video games for once, would you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Everything will be great.
It's Friday night, and Ben's preparing his date with Maria when he gets a phone call.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, dude, you ready for your big date?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You bringing her anything?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm supposed to bring her something?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Haven't you been on a date before?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, uh... You know... Now that I think about it... No.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni was my first girlfriend, and it just kind of happened.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And Jessica and I... Well, it probably wouldn't have mattered what happened on the first date.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounds like she had her heart set on someone lame enough to fall for her, and that was me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you sure this dating thing is a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! This is how you prove that you're not lame! Oh, and Kale...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bring her something nice.
Ben sighs and hangs up.
At the store a few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I haven't really talked to Maria... I don't even know what she likes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wonder what I should get.
Ben looks around and finds flowers and candy at the front of the store.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer said to get one thing... But which?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope you really enjoy your dates... Considering you paid with my money!

nodes.text: Oh, they're not for me...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't like chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, it's just... I like to be healthy.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But I like your gift.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Shall we go?
Ben and Maria walk into one of the fanciest restaurants in town and are greeted by the Captain of the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Ahoy, me mateys! Welcome to The `Heaaaaart of the Sea!`... The most romantic pirate-themed restaurant in town!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahoy, me mateys! Welcome to The [color=#e23b3b][i]Heaaaaart of the Sea![/i][/color]... The most romantic pirate-themed restaurant in town!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahoy!

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: I'll be gettin' ye a table now...
The Captain leads Maria and Ben past a lush gallery of plants.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ben... Is that Hector hiding by that flower pot?
Ben looks over and sees Hector is indeed hiding behind a flower pot.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wonder what he's doing...
The Captain shows them to their table.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Avast, ye lass and landlubber... Here we are...
Ben and Maria sit down and look through their menus.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know... I'm really excited about tonight.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I've always thought you were cute, but you were dating Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And I was dating Jacob... Who, by the way, is a total jerk...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So I'm glad it's just you and me. I know all about you!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You used to be way into science, you pulled an awesome prank on Wilson...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You really care about the school... You always say so in your speeches.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And unlike a certain `guy` I used to date...
nodes.text_bbcode: And unlike a certain [color=#3b78e2][i]guy[/i][/color] I used to date...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You seem like the type of guy who is really committed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow, you do know a lot about me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Of course! I research all the interesting people at Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think I'm interesting?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Totally.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're much better than blonde, dumb jocks whose names rhyme with 'Macob'...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, uh, thanks. But I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know that much about you...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, that's why we're on this date, right? To get to know each other?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So tell me about yourself.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm really into fashion and dance.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I used to help Jessica choreograph our cheerleading routines. There's this awesome one I just did to my favorite band, the Royal T's!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The Royal T's?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: They're a British boy band. Totally hot.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I mean, other than that... I'm also really into movies. I've wanted to be in one ever since I was a little kid.
A silence falls between them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Do you want to know anything else about me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd really like to know more about...
Ben hands her the flowers.
