nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... Where are we going?
A short while later...
Ben and Nicole are finishing up their picnic dinner on a blanket at the beach.
Together, they watch the sun set against the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It was cool of you to bring a picnic... You're, like, so hot...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you like it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, totally! I don't know many guys who can cook.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If by 'cook', you mean... Buy take out sandwiches at Pepperoni Toni's, then yes.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hee hee.
She scoots closer to him, so that they're sitting shoulder to shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Nicole

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? What are you looking at? Aren't you running late?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you ever think we'd end up like this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, married?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean... working all the time... Never seeing each other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I always thought we'd spend more time together, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, what's gotten into you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was just thinking... What if I had gotten into Kingston? What if Ryan hadn't been there to interrupt my interview?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you think our lives would have been much different?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where this is coming from, Howard... But, yes, of course our lives would have been different!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you mind telling me what's going on in that balding head of yours?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing. Just, you know, daydreaming...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, let's daydream our way to work.
Well... $ZOE and Howard are together in this ending, but it doesn't seem very happy, does it?
Play again and see if you can get a better ending, one where Howard doesn't have to lift his belly just to see his belt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, would it be all right if I took a raincheck on dinner with your family?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... Is something up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry. It's nothing for you to be concerned about or anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you scheming to try and cheer me up again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'll tell my family you say 'hi'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!
Howard kisses $ZOE and walks into his house...
As soon as he's gone, $ZOE takes out her phone and calls up Angie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie... I need a favor!
That night, $ZOE meets up with the representative from Kingston University.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for seeing me on such short notice.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Indeed. Angie spoke highly of you.
The professor takes a bite of a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I'll admit I was a bit concerned for my safety, meeting a strange student in a park at night...

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: But I can't imagine being mugged by someone who makes muffins as delicious as these!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Now tell me, dear, what is so important for you to meet me at such a late hour?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have to give Howard another chance!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Howard? The boy who got into a fight before our interview even began?

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I don't think so! Kingston Kings do not behave like street scoundrels!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: If that's what this is about, then I'm afraid you've wasted both of our times!
Tears begin to well up in $ZOE's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard isn't who you think he is.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: You seem to care very deeply for him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do! I'm... I'm asking you to give him another chance!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I don't think I can do that... Unless you can somehow prove to me that he isn't the scoundrel I know him to be!
$ZOE racks her brain, trying to come up with something on the spot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Exactly as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait!
She shows him the pendant on the necklace hanging from her neck. It's a duck, facing to the left.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I was really down once, Howard bought me this. Ducks are kind of our thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He has a matching duck pendant that faces the opposite direction. They're both magnetized, so that when the two of them are next to each other, they kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He said that it's a reminder that whenever we're apart, I'm pulled to him... Just as he's pulled to me.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: That's... Actually very sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that's Howard. He's sweet and thoughtful and caring and kind... And just as I'm the kind of girl who brings muffins to a park...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's the kind of guy who buys duck pendants to cheer me up... He's the kind of guy who doesn't get in fights, the kind of guy who belongs at a school like yours!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Will you give him another chance?

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I'll have to sleep on it... Good night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Good night.
He walks away, leaving $ZOE to wonder...
The next morning, $ZOE's phone buzzes, waking her up. She answers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? Did I wake you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about it... You sound happy... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'll never guess! I got a call from the Kingston representative... He decided to give me a second chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That's amazing! Did he say why?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but who cares? It's happening today! Will you help me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Meet me at my house!
Howard hangs up. As $ZOE lets the moment sink in, her heart is filled with joy once again...
...Only this time, the feeling lasts.
You played a great game! You helped $ZOE cheer Howard up on his tour of Centerscore U.
And you also helped her realize that it wasn't the school for him... You helped her make the ultimate sacrifice!
The only question is... Can Howard prove that he's a Kingston King? Find out in the Season 12 Finale!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do next?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do next?

nodes.text: One by one, all the friends, all the people whose life Howard was a part of, walk up to the stage and speak for him.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What can I say? Howard's my best man.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whether it's proving our innocence after being wrongly accused or throwing the best party ever...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's awesome! I know that Howard's got my back. We're friends for life.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love Howard!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But not more then Hector!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: All the cheerleaders loved having Howard around! He's so sweet and nice!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And good-looking and hot, and you should `totally` see him in his football uniform and...
nodes.text_bbcode: And good-looking and hot, and you should [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] see him in his football uniform and...

nodes.text: $ZOE plucks the mic out of Nicole's hands and passes it on.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Howard's been a great football captain. He's always been there for us football players. On and off the field.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We trust him to lead us, and he really deserves the very best.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Speaking for the nerds, Howard's never picked on any of us!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But more than that, he's a good guy to lean on.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He got me through a very hard time when I was breaking up with my ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I've been much happier since then!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I could have lunch with one historical figure, it'd be Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: After him, it'd be... Well, it'd probably be Abe Lincoln.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then Martin Luther King would be a hoot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if it had to be a guy who was still alive, it'd be Howard!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't entirely hate his guts.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Anyone with a girlfriend that hot has to be doing something right.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: He's an average guy.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd even say he's okay.
They sit down, and $ZOE speaks into the mic.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For them, that's a compliment!
Everyone in the crowd laughs, and $ZOE waits for them to calm down.
Then she takes a breath and starts speaking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think this whole school is going to miss Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As football captain, team leader, and positive friend, Howard's touched all of our lives in an unforgettable way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Loyal and kind, fierce and gentle... Howard is one of the best guys around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll miss you, Howard.
At $ZOE finishes her speech, Howard takes the microphone and addresses the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All I have to say is... Thank you. Thank you, everyone, for your kind words.
Howard steps down to everyone's applause.
As people file off the field, Bertram meets Howard and $ZOE at the edges of the football field.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Howard, I was wrong about you.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I said that you were missing the one spark that would make you a real leader.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But after seeing everyone here speak up for you...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I know for certain that you're a real Kingston King. Congratulations, you're in.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? I am?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He is?!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: He is.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: And young lady...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We reward initiative at Kingston, and I believe your ability to gather such a crowd for a cause you care about is an impressive feat.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: We could use someone with your influence. When your time comes, you should consider applying for Kingston too.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: You would be a resourceful Kingston King, er, Queen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I will!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Now Howard, you're going to be flying out first thing tomorrow morning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Tomorrow?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Tomorrow?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Yes, there's a summer training orientation for Kingston Kings. It starts at 9 o'clock sharp.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'll see you there.
Bertram heads out, and Howard and $ZOE look sadly at one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm happy I got in, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm leaving tomorrow.
Howard looks down at $ZOE whose eyes have suddenly filled with tears.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I... I think this is goodbye for us.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: After all our time together, after we got you back from Paris, after everything else...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It doesn't seem fair.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe we... We could make it work... You know, long-distance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...No. I don't think we can. We've `seen` what that does to people. We've seen how it goes.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...No. I don't think we can. We've [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] what that does to people. We've seen how it goes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to remember us like this, Howard. Happy. Fulfilled. In love. Not... Not torn apart and longing and jealous.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should end on a good note. It's right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just don't forget about me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never.
Howard pulls $ZOE into a fierce hug.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But this isn't goodbye forever, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's not.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You heard Mr. Bloomsburg. Maybe when it's time for me to graduate... We can be together...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But until then...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Goodbye, Howard...
She leans into him, their foreheads touching. He pushes a lock of hair out of her face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Goodbye, $ZOE... I'll always love you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'll always love you.
A warm breeze envelops them as Howard and $ZOE kiss for the last time in the fading summer light.
Well, that was a hard ending, but it is the good one! Congratulations! You helped Howard get into Kingston and have a good last moment with $ZOE!
But what will happen to $ZOE now that Howard's gone? Find out during the next school year of Surviving High School!
The microphone gets passed on through the crowd, each person voicing their opinion of Howard.
Unfortunately, it starts out bad... And becomes worse...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Howard is, like, totally hot.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah! Totally!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Howard `is` the coach of our football team...
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] the coach of our football team...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But other than that, he's a perfectly average guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is totally not helping my case...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Howard's been the best wingman a guy could have.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's been by my side for every heist, every prank, and every illegal thing we've done!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `Illegal?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Illegal?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... It's probably just a figure of speech?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard, good buddy, good pal... We've had a lot of good times making our rap sheets as long as possible! Live the dream!
Hector passes the mic on to Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Howard's a total tool with his total tool girlfriend and his total tool football team.
$ZOE wrests the microphone away from Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, that's all the encouragement we need! Thanks for turning out!
As everyone leaves the football field, $ZOE runs up to them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That didn't go as well as I'd hoped.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please, Mr. Bloomsburg... I'm sorry. I gathered everyone here to show you how important Howard was to the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope I didn't leave you with a bad impression of him.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I've heard enough about Howard.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: A sordid relationship with the law, a tenuous grasp of friendship, and no honors of note.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I'm hard-pressed to imagine that Kingston would accept anyone who keeps such company.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...
Bertram turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: But `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Pulling together this entire event belies your passion, your resourcefulness, and your ingenuity.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: $ZOE, how would you like to enroll into our Kingston King program?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? But she's not even graduating!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: In the exception of exceptional students, we consider early acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is such an honor, sir...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I can say 'no'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I accept!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Great. I'll send along the details. We'll meet at the airport tomorrow!
$ZOE turns to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard. But you know how good a school Kingston is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't pass this up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you... But I have to go pack!
$ZOE kisses him on the cheek and runs off!
$ZOE boards a plane for Kingston while Howard gets rejected?
We don't have to tell you that this is a terrible ending!
Try again and see if you can help Howard `wow` Bertram!
nodes.text_bbcode: Try again and see if you can help Howard [b]wow[/b] Bertram!

That night, Brendan's bedroom window slides open and Taylor steps in, wearing her old cheerleader uniform.
Uh... What's going on?
Well, $ZOE came to me for cheerleading advice, and it made me think of old times.
You know, about back when I was Head Cheerleader.
You're not thinking about going back, are you?
Pfft! Never! Again!
But... I did think it would be fun to play out a fantasy of mine...
Urrrrrrb... Uh... Wass of glater! Er, glass of water!
Relax, Brendan.
Taylor holds up a bunch of character sheets...
See where I'm going with this?
Oh, heh. I think I do... A little role-playing...
Exactly!
Twenty minutes later...
Brendan is wearing a red sweater as a wig. He talks with an odd, airy voice.
I'm Amanda! Yay, Squirrels!
I'm $ZOE! I'm so sweet and innocent! How are we ever going to beat Wilson in the big tournament?!
I don't know! Any ideas, Hecky?
Brendan takes off the wig and deepens his voice...
Uh... Something cool! Our Head Cheerleader, Taylor, will think of something!
Hee hee! I love how into this you are, Brendan!
Brendan? You mean, that really awesome nerd? He's not here... He's off... Discovering the cure for every disease ever created.
Okay, okay...
Taylor closes her eyes, getting into character... She opens them.
Amanda! Hector! Get into formation!
$ZOE, you're going to be thrown into the air, so get ready!
Spotlight on me!
Whoa! It's like watching your Ogres 'N' Elves character in real life.
Without the bow and arrows, of course.
Taylor sighs...
I wasn't the best Head Cheerleader, Brendan. But I had my moments...
I'm sure you did.
Oh, hey, look...
Brendan rolls a twenty-sided die...
I rolled a twelve. You know what that means, right?
No...
Any former Head Cheerleaders in the room have to kiss any non-Head Cheerleaders...
I guess that means I have to kiss you.
I guess you do.
Taylor gets close to Brendan, and they kiss!
You like the cheerleader uniform, don't you?
Well... It doesn't fit me as well as I thought it would...
Hee hee! I love you!
I love you too!
Awww! What a sweet moment between Taylor and Brendan! Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!

Ever wondered what Hector was doing at the Heaaaaart of the Sea?
Find out now!
Rewinding back to Ben and Maria's date at the most romantic pirate-themed restaurant in town...
Ben and Maria are getting shown to their table...
Ben... Is that Hector hiding by that flower pot?
I wonder what he's doing...
As Maria and Ben get seated, Hector cranes his neck around the flower pot.
This spot is perfect! I have a great view of the table Amanda and Erik are sitting at!
They're not getting away from me!
Hello, scary pirate waiter... We want the Ships and Dip appetizer...
And then I'll have the Swim with the Sharks Platter...
And I'll take the Cannon Meatball Frigate.
These names are so funny!
Behind the pot, Hector glares at Erik.
Stupid Erik...
Hector watches Amanda laugh at something Erik said.
Outbidding me at the auction...
Take my girlfriend out on a date...
But I know why you did it...
You're stealing her from under my nose!
Amanda, ever since Valentine's Day...
I wanted to tell you how I feel...
I already know!
You do?
Amanda puts her hand on Erik's shoulder.
Yes! And I have to tell you, Erik, that you are the most special bunny!
Okay, things have gone `too far!`
Hector rolls out from his hiding place and springs forward!
He dives across a table, sending glassware crashing to the ground!
Sorry, but I've got a date to crash!
Hector weaves around several people, upsetting waiters serving huge platters of food.
He storms up to the table!
Stop it right now! This date is done!
Hecky-Wecky...
Why are you so angry?
Because I know what's going on here!
You... You do?
Yeah! You're trying to confess your feelings!
Well, don't even bother! She doesn't like you back!
She doesn't?
Nope!
Erik and Amanda both look down.
Oh...
Oh no...
Sniff... Sniff... I thought Ashley really `did` like me...
Erik starts tearing up.
Me too...
Wait, the girl you like is Ashley?
Yeah... Amanda gave me good advice on Valentine's Day, and I wanted to tell her I was grateful for it.
So... You weren't planning to tell my girlfriend that you had a crush on her?
No... Sniff...
Sniff... Erik, you're making me cry...
Well, now I feel bad...
Suddenly, Hector feels himself being lifted up by a formidable pirate!
Aarrrrrrrrr! Ye should feel bad!
We have a house rule... Ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!
Whoa... Hold on... It was just a misunderstanding!
The way I misunderstand it... It looks to me like ye made `two` ladies cry!
Erik's a boy!
I do have feminine facial features...
It's off to the plank with you!
Hey, wait! No!
Amanda, explain it! Quickly!
Sorry... But you broke the rules, Hecky...
`Noooo!`
Well... Looks like Hector learned his lesson. That's what happens when you show up to angrily break up a date between your girlfriend and someone else!
And that's it for your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High School!

The next day...
It's graduation day!
Angie stands on the stage, finishing up her valedictorian speech...
And that was when I realized that all the love potions and color-coded schedules didn't mean anything if I didn't have friends to share them with!
Everyone politely applauds. Angie smiles and sits down.
Well! That was an insightful and moderately alarming speech...

And now, I'd like to take a moment to make a very special announcement! While the results of the Presidential election were delayed due to... The controversy... I'm now pleased to announce they've been completely tallied up!
The next Student Body President of Twin Branches High will be...
Taylor Vale!
Seriously? `Seriously?`
The other candidates glance among themselves...
...Good for you, Taylor.
Hey... The important thing is I tried.
There's always next year, right?
I can't believe this happened...
My bracelet matches my toenails!
Taylor stands up and faces the crowd.
This is a huge honor... Really. I promise I won't let you guys down!
The room bursts into thunderous applause! Taylor stands up and takes a bow. After the noise finally settles...
And now, let's have a word from our outgoing football team captain, Howard!
Howard walks up and takes the mic...
Hey, guys.
I've done a lot of thinking over the last few days... Thinking about what this school has meant to me... Thinking about what I'm leaving behind.
Yesterday, I was worried I wouldn't be able to say goodbye. That it would be too hard. That there are just too many good memories here...
But today, I understand that that's the wrong way to look at it. `I'll` always have those memories, even if I'm not here anymore.
I'll always remember all the good times. All the crazy times. All the laughs and tears and adventures.
My fellow seniors are probably thinking about the very different roads ahead of them...
Some of you incoming seniors are probably thinking back on the great times you've had here...
While others of you are thinking about all the great times still to come.
The important thing is to not get stuck in the past. To not worry too much about decisions you could have made differently, or wonder what could have been.
Today, I'm looking forward. I'm looking to my future. And I think it looks pretty bright.
I wouldn't be who I am today if it wasn't for all of you. And I couldn't have asked for a better high school experience.
I love you guys. Happy graduation!
Everyone cheers!

$ZOE whispers in his ear...
That was beautiful.
`You're` beautiful.
$ZOE gives Howard a kiss on the cheek.
Happy graduation.
Yeah.
Yeah, it is.
Looks like Howard made peace with graduating and is looking forward to his future! Great job!
But what will the summer hold? And will he and $ZOE really be able to make it work?

How did Erik end up at the beach?
Let's go back in time to find out!
I just find it ironic that you're so into patriotism and the 4th of July, but when it comes to helping out your friends, `your school,` you'd rather make out with some girl instead.
Justin storms out of the room... A moment later, Prissy comes back in...
Everything okay? 'Cause your friend just, like, bailed.
Um... Yeah...
Yeah! Everything's just dandy!
I'm really excited for more of these private talks!
About that, Erik...
Uh huh...
I like you as a friend and all, hard as that is for me to believe, but...
Fire-roasted hot dogs, Justin was right! You're not really into me, are you?
Well... No, but I am very into you `right now!`
That seems morally rephrehens...
Prissy suddenly cups her hand over Erik's mouth.
Shh! Listen!
Outside the cabin, they can hear the sound of the Wilson elites...
This is the same cabin we were just at, Alexei. We're totally lost!
Shut up, Steve! We just went the wrong way! All we have to do is get to our cars and then we can drive to the pier!
Even if those idiots do warn Center`bore,` they'll never suspect us coming from the ocean!
Heh heh! Unless they do!
Seriously, what is your problem?!
Back inside, Erik whispers to Prissy...
The ocean?! Justin's warning isn't going to be enough.
Are you seriously going to leave when you have a second chance to make out with me!
As statistically improbable as this is, Prissy, I've got a duty!
A duty to my friends, to my school, to my people!
And... Well, also this would be a really great chance to re-enact an uncannily similar moment to one in history made by my historical idol soooooo... Bye!
Erik grabs the glowsticks from the gift bag and bounds out of the cabin...
Immediately stopping in his tracks...
Oh, nuts! I forgot that I don't have a bike...
That's when Erik sees the small stable attached to the back of the cabin, a horse staring right at him...
Whinny!
Well, saddle me up and call me Mr. Paul Revere!
Erik saddles up the horse and hops on!
Neeeeigh!
Easy, girl! At least, I think you're a girl...
Erik points in the direction of the ocean!
Tonight... We ride! `Hyah!`
Erik flips the reins, and the horse gallops off through the woods, the glowsticks lighting the way!
Looks like Erik did make the right choice after all! And he got to role-play his hero, Paul Revere!
Have a happy 4th of July! Have fun, and be safe!

Wonder what Hannah and everyone else got up to later that evening?
Let's check it out!
You know what? I've had enough fun for one night...
Sorry, guys, but I need to turn in.
Sara yawns and turns back towards her hotel room. Hannah shrugs.
Her loss. Come on, I'm starving. Let's get something to eat!
Hannah, Zach, Lee, and Amanda take off.
Behind them, Jane and Cameron lag.
What are you looking at?
Just wondering if you were going with them.
Why? Does that determine what you're going to do?
Yeah, actually.
Why?
Well, you seem to have a bad impression of me.
And I can't have that. If we spent some time hanging out...
You think you're going to convince me that you're not that bad once I get to know you?
It's cliche, but it's true.
Come along, and you can tell me all about how the media portrays women as vessels incapable of independent thought.
...You have been listening to me!
I'm a smart guy.
All right... I'll go.
Together, they follow Hannah and the group.
We never get to eat this much in cheerleading.
That's why swimming's awesome!
They're shown to a table.
Hey, guys... Don't look now, but I think I see Hawk Gunner!
Inside?
Where?
Hannah points in his direction.
The Hawk requires a waiter. Quickly! The Hawk waits for no man!
Gasp! It is him! I can't believe it!
I'm going to get his autograph...
I'm going with you. I don't trust that guy.
They walk over to Hawk's table.
Hawk Gunner! I'm a big fan. Can I get your signature?
The Hawk will do anything for a chick-ling like you...
Where do you want me to sign, chickadee?
Uh... I don't have anything...
Hannah takes a napkin from the table.
What about this?
The Hawk does not sign `napkins`...
Oh...
Uh...
But Hawk will sign `body parts`...
Ew... Not when you say it like that...
How about this? Why don't you come over and hang out... In my nest?
No, that's okay...
Hawk puts his hand on hers.
It'll be a Hawk-casion to remember...
Okay, that's it... She said no, man!
Zach tackles Hawk to the ground. When he stands up again, he grins at Hannah.
That tool was totally asking for it!
That tool is right behind you! Duck!
Hawk charges into Zach!
They crash into a table nearby, causing plates, glasses, and food to crash to the floor!
Zach!
Zach and Hawk pop right back up!
`Zach Attack!`
`Hawk-ah!`
Check, please!
I can't believe we got kicked out of the restaurant for rowdy behavior...
I wasn't even protesting!
Okay, so that part sucked.
But who saw Zach try to get into a fight with Hawk just for me?
I did! I saw it!
Can we just forget that part of the evening ever happened? What are we doing next?
Anyone feel like taking a midnight swim in the lake?
Later on in the woods...
The swimmers huddle around a fire, trying to get warm.
Whoo! Jumping in the lake was intense!
Dude, that was `cold.`
I'm pretty sure I saw ice in that water...
I can't feel my legs... Are they gone?
Well, `I'm` glad I went. Good idea, Hannah.
Aww, thanks, Zach...
Hey, uh, Hannah... You're kind of cool... Maybe you want to, you know, hang out sometime?
We are hanging out.
I mean, when we're actually at school.
We hang out at school too...
I mean... Like on a date.
Geez, I know that. I was kidding. You're too easy.
But what about the 'date' part?
Yeah. That sounds good to me.
Zach puts an arm around her and pulls her closer.
Meanwhile, Lee and Amanda warm their hands by the fire and talk.
So, uh, Amanda... You're, uh... On both the cheerleading team and the swimming team?
Weird, isn't it?
It's like I'm in two different places at once!
Uh, yeah, something like that, I guess.
And elsewhere, a small ways away from the others...
Cameron and Jane sit close together and dry off in front of the fire.
So you're never going to date anyone?
I didn't say that. I just want the guy I start dating seriously to be smart and politically aware.
I'd never date `you,` for instance.
Hey! I said it before... I'm a smart guy.
If you were so smart, you'd know that Sara wasn't into you.
Trust me, I figured that one out quick.
Besides... I'm not that into Sara.
He cocks an eyebrow at Jane.
What would you say if I was interested in you?
Can't say I'm not tempted...
But, Cameron... Don't think this is going anywhere.
Wouldn't dream of it.
Well, it looks like everyone managed to have an interesting time on their night out!
And that's it for your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shove it, will you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ben just completely abandoned Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It just confirms what I already knew... People are the worst!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's it!
Sam presses the SEND key, submitting her post to the Dirty Dish...
A few minutes later, word has spread all over the island...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe someone would do this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe it's not so bad... I mean, your dad's a little out of touch... Maybe he won't find out about it...
A second later, Sara's phone rings...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no... It's him...
Nearby, Sam watches on gleefully... She turns... And runs right into $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it was you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? Consider us through!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Through? We're family! It's not like you can break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I just did! Don't ever talk to me again! Goodbye!
$ZOE marches away!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE...
Sam looks back at the sad faces of Sara and Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I went a little too far... But it's too late now...
Too late indeed! With Colt going to juvie, Nick and Sara on the verge of breaking up, and $ZOE disowning Sam, you might have guessed it...
This isn't the Good Ending! Play again and see if you can help Ben and Sam with both of their situations!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was `my idea!` Colt didn't have anything to do with it!
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#e23b3b][i]my idea![/i][/color] Colt didn't have anything to do with it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Tweed, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Colt? You mean the kid we've already got a full rap sheet on? If he didn't have anything to do with this, I'm a concert pianist.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, then I'd like to hear you play because I'm telling the truth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it's an unlikely scenario, but I bet you didn't expect us to have a pig with us when you stopped us, did you?

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: `Oink! Oink!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oink! Oink![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well... No...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unlikely scenarios `can` happen, and this is one of them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Unlikely scenarios [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] happen, and this is one of them.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tweed! You don't know what you're doing...
Ben ignores Colt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig `and` operate this boat.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Officer, this party is mine. I missed the ferry. I was desperate to get across, but I couldn't watch my pig [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] operate this boat.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt was walking by, so I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not how it happened.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, Colt was riding by on his motorcycle, looking super cool, then I flagged him down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's not what I meant!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I do remember something in his past about a motorcycle...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, I told him I'd compensate him for taking the trip with me, but he didn't know I was stealing the boat... I told him it was mine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm telling you, that's not what happened!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me the real story, Colt?
Colt starts to talk, but then he looks at Ben...
And something in him gives...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Tweed's right. That's... That's how it happened...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: This story stinks like a... Like a pig in a boat!

nodes.speaker: Pig
nodes.text: Oink!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A second ago you were disagreeing with him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get `him` free...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought you'd believe that I had nothing to do with it... I figured I'd at least try to get [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] free...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You gotta believe me. Don't send an innocent kid to juvenile hall.
Monte stares hard at Ben and Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine. You seem like a good kid, so I'll believe you. Even though I don't know what kind of a name 'Tweed' is...
The officer looks at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You can go... But... I'll be keeping an eye out for you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
The officer handcuffs Ben and escorts him onto the Coast Guard ship. The boat heads back to the mainland...
Nearby, Sam looks at the message she's typed out on her phone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe Ben did that for Colt... It was so stupid and... And unselfish.
Suddenly the message Sam's written seems petty and utterly wrong.
Without another moment's hesitation, she deletes the message.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll never even `think` about doing something like that again!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll never even [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about doing something like that again!

nodes.text: After word of what happened travels around the island, Denni comes up to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben really got taken away?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, and it wasn't even his fault... I mean... I didn't think we were gonna get caught!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're not pissed off at me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You were just being you... And I know you took the boat because you thought coming to the party was important to me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Granted, it wasn't your `finest` hour...
nodes.text_bbcode: Granted, it wasn't your [color=#3b78e2][i]finest[/i][/color] hour...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry... I'll try not to kick you while you're down...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's going to happen to Ben?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't think it'll be too bad for him... Just a fine and some community service.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, that's not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Kind of a `friendly` thing for him to do, wasn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of a [color=#3b78e2][i]friendly[/i][/color] thing for him to do, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I hear you.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course, Princess! Let's go make out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sigh. Sure.
Looks like Ben's actions inspired Sam to do the right thing and eased friction between him and Colt.
You played a great game! You helped Sam stay calm in a tough situation, you helped Ben make a tremendous sacrifice...
And weird as it is, you also managed to help Ben escort a huge pig to an island party! Great job!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes?
Howard reaches into his pocket and swiftly reaches up to $ZOE's face, smearing frosting on her nose!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Eee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Eee![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Told you I'd get you back for the window trick!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've been keeping frosting in your pocket this whole day?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Anything for prank revenge!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you got me. Now at least help me clean it off.
Howard helps clean the frosting off of $ZOE's face, the two of them giggling...
She is filled with a sudden happiness...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Given that you have prior experience fencing, there's no need for me to clarify the rules of engagement...
He taps the tip of his blade against Howard's.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: `...EN GARDE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...EN GARDE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, but... Wouldn't it be, er... More `gentlemanly` to make all the rules absolutely clear?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, but... Wouldn't it be, er... More [color=#e23b3b][i]gentlemanly[/i][/color] to make all the rules absolutely clear?

nodes.text: Bertram lowers his blade...

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: I suppose you're correct... Very well..
Bertram bows politely to Howard, and Howard returns the gesture.

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: Very well done... You are a man of honor. You may have proven yourself to be Kingston material after all!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? ...Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Bertram
nodes.text: ...Not that our day is over just yet, of course.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course...
